sections.label: Invocation
sections.name: मुक्ति जन्म महि जानि ग्यान खानि अघ हानि कर

verses.sa:
कुन्देन्दीवरसुन्दरावतिबलौ विज्ञानधामावुभौ ।
शोभाढ्यौ वरधन्विनौ श्रुतिनुतौ गोविप्रवृन्दप्रियौ ।
मायामानुषरूपिणौ रघुवरौ सद्धर्मवर्मौं हितौ ।
सीतान्वेषणतत्परौ पथिगतौ भक्तिप्रदौ तौ हि नः ॥
verses.tr:
kundendīvarasundarāvatibalau vijñānadhāmāvubhau
śobhāḍhyau varadhanvinau śrutinutau govipravṛndapriyau
māyāmānuṣarūpiṇau raghuvarau saddharmavarmauṃ hitau
sītānveṣaṇatatparau pathigatau bhaktipradau tau hi naḥ
verses.head: श्लोक

verses.sa:
ब्रह्माम्भोधिसमुद्भवं कलिमलप्रध्वंसनं चाव्ययं ।
श्रीमच्छम्भुमुखेन्दुसुन्दरवरे संशोभितं सर्वदा ।
संसारामयभेषजं सुखकरं श्रीजानकीजीवनं ।
धन्यास्ते कृतिनः पिबन्ति सततं श्रीरामनामामृतम् ॥
verses.tr:
brahmāmbhodhisamudbhavaṃ kalimalapradhvaṃsanaṃ cāvyayaṃ
śrīmacchambhumukhendusundaravare saṃśobhitaṃ sarvadā
saṃsārāmayabheṣajaṃ sukhakaraṃ śrījānakījīvanaṃ
dhanyāste kṛtinaḥ pibanti satataṃ śrīrāmanāmāmṛtam

verses.sa:
मुक्ति जन्म महि जानि ग्यान खानि अघ हानि कर ।
जहँ बस संभु भवानि सो कासी सेइअ कस न ॥
verses.tr:
mukti janm mahi jāni gyān khāni agh hāni kar
jaham̐ bas saṃbhu bhavāni so kāsī seia kas na
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
जरत सकल सुर बृंद बिषम गरल जेहिं पान किय ।
तेहि न भजसि मन मंद को कृपाल संकर सरिस ॥
verses.tr:
jarat sakal sur bṛṃd biṣam garal jehiṃ pān kiya
tehi na bhajasi man maṃd ko kṛpāl saṃkar saris

trans: BEA.UTIFUL as the jasmine or the lotus, of surpassing strength, store-honses of wisdom, all glorious and accomplished bowmen, hymned by the Vedas, benefactors of cows and Brahmans, may they who appeared in the form of mortal men as the two noble sons of Raghu, the champions of true religion, the wayfarers intent on their search for Sita, may they grant us faith.

Blessed are the pious souls, who ever imbibe the nectar of holy Rama’s name; nectar, the product of no ocean, but of Brahm himself, the utter exterminator of all the impurities of this sinful age, the imperishable, the quintessence of the beauty of blessed Sambhu’s moonlike face, the ever glorious, the remedy for all the diseases of life, the exquisitely sweet, the life of blessed Janaki.

How is it possible not to reverence Kasi, the home of Sambhu and Bhavani, knowing it to be the earthly birthplace of salvation, a treasury of knowledge and the destroyer of sin. Dull indeed of soul is the man who worships not him, who when all the hosts of heaven were in distress, drank up the deadly poison; who is so merciful as Sankara?

sections.label: Doha 1
sections.name: जग कारन तारन भव भंजन धरनी भार

verses.sa:
आगें चले बहुरि रघुराया ।
रिष्यमूक परवत निअराया ॥
verses.tr:
āgeṃ cale bahuri raghurāyā
riṣyamūk paravat niarāyā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तहँ रह सचिव सहित सुग्रीवा ।
आवत देखि अतुल बल सींवा ॥
verses.tr:
taham̐ rah saciv sahit sugrīvā
āvat dekhi atul bal sīṃvā

verses.sa:
अति सभीत कह सुनु हनुमाना ।
पुरुष जुगल बल रूप निधाना ॥
verses.tr:
ati sabhīt kah sunu hanumānā
puruṣ jugal bal rūp nidhānā

verses.sa:
धरि बटु रूप देखु तैं जाई ।
कहेसु जानि जियँ सयन बुझाई ॥
verses.tr:
dhari baṭu rūp dekhu taiṃ jāī
kahesu jāni jiyam̐ sayan bujhāī

verses.sa:
पठए बालि होहिं मन मैला ।
भागौं तुरत तजौं यह सैला ॥
verses.tr:
paṭhae bāli hohiṃ man mailā
bhāgauṃ turat tajauṃ yah sailā

verses.sa:
बिप्र रूप धरि कपि तहँ गयऊ ।
माथ नाइ पूछत अस भयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
bipr rūp dhari kapi taham̐ gayaū
māth nāi pūchat as bhayaū

verses.sa:
को तुम्ह स्यामल गौर सरीरा ।
छत्री रूप फिरहु बन बीरा ॥
verses.tr:
ko tumh syāmal gaur sarīrā
chatrī rūp phirahu ban bīrā

verses.sa:
कठिन भूमि कोमल पद गामी ।
कवन हेतु बिचरहु बन स्वामी ॥
verses.tr:
kaṭhin bhūmi komal pad gāmī
kavan hetu bicarahu ban svāmī

verses.sa:
मृदुल मनोहर सुंदर गाता ।
सहत दुसह बन आतप बाता ॥
verses.tr:
mṛdul manohar suṃdar gātā
sahat dusah ban ātap bātā

verses.sa:
की तुम्ह तीनि देव महँ कोऊ ।
नर नारायन की तुम्ह दोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
kī tumh tīni dev maham̐ koū
nar nārāyan kī tumh doū

verses.sa:
जग कारन तारन भव भंजन धरनी भार ।
की तुम्ह अकिल भुवन पति लीन्ह मनुज अवतार ॥
verses.tr:
jag kāran tāran bhav bhaṃjan dharanī bhār
kī tumh akil bhuvan pati līnh manuj avatār
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Rama again proceeded on his way and drew near to the mountain Rishyamika. ‘There Sugriva dwelt with his ministers, who, seeing them approach in all their immeasurable strength, was exceedingly alarmed and cried: “Hearken, Hanuman; take the form of a young Brahman student and go and see who these two heroes are, of such remarkable strength and beauty, and when you have ascertained make some sign by which I may know also. If that wretch BAli has sent them, I must leave the hill and flee at once.” The monkey assumed the form of a Brahman and went to the place; there bowed his head and thus questioned them: ‘« Who are you two knights of warrior mien, who roam this wood, one dark of hue, the other fair? The ground is rough for your soft feet to tread. What isthe reason, my masters, that you visit this forest Your body is too delicate and exquisitely beautiful to be exposed to the intolerable sun and wind of these wild regions. Who are you? A Person of the Trinity; or the two great gods Nara and Narayan?! Doha 1.
Or has the lord of all the spheres become incarnate in your human form, for the good of the world to bridge the ocean of existence and relieve earth of its burdens?”

sections.label: Doha 2
sections.name: एकु मैं मंद मोहबस कुटिल हृदय अग्यान

verses.sa:
कोसलेस दसरथ के जाए ।
हम पितु बचन मानि बन आए ॥
verses.tr:
kosales dasarath ke jāe
ham pitu bacan māni ban āe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नाम राम लछिमन दौउ भाई ।
संग नारि सुकुमारि सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
nām rām lachiman dauu bhāī
saṃg nāri sukumāri suhāī

verses.sa:
इहाँ हरि निसिचर बैदेही ।
बिप्र फिरहिं हम खोजत तेही ॥
verses.tr:
ihām̐ hari nisicar baidehī
bipr phirahiṃ ham khojat tehī

verses.sa:
आपन चरित कहा हम गाई ।
कहहु बिप्र निज कथा बुझाई ॥
verses.tr:
āpan carit kahā ham gāī
kahahu bipr nij kathā bujhāī

verses.sa:
प्रभु पहिचानि परेउ गहि चरना ।
सो सुख उमा नहिं बरना ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu pahicāni pareu gahi caranā
so sukh umā nahiṃ baranā

verses.sa:
पुलकित तन मुख आव न बचना ।
देखत रुचिर बेष कै रचना ॥
verses.tr:
pulakit tan mukh āv na bacanā
dekhat rucir beṣ kai racanā

verses.sa:
पुनि धीरजु धरि अस्तुति कीन्ही ।
हरष हृदयँ निज नाथहि चीन्ही ॥
verses.tr:
puni dhīraju dhari astuti kīnhī
haraṣ hṛdayam̐ nij nāthahi cīnhī

verses.sa:
मोर न्याउ मैं पूछा साईं ।
तुम्ह पूछहु कस नर की नाईं ॥
verses.tr:
mor nyāu maiṃ pūchā sāīṃ
tumh pūchahu kas nar kī nāīṃ

verses.sa:
तव माया बस फिरउँ भुलाना ।
ता ते मैं नहिं प्रभु पहिचाना ॥
verses.tr:
tav māyā bas phiraum̐ bhulānā
tā te maiṃ nahiṃ prabhu pahicānā

verses.sa:
एकु मैं मंद मोहबस कुटिल हृदय अग्यान ।
पुनि प्रभु मोहि बिसारेउ दीनबंधु भगवान ॥
verses.tr:
eku maiṃ maṃd mohabas kuṭil hṛdaya agyān
puni prabhu mohi bisāreu dīnabaṃdhu bhagavān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: “« We are the sons of Dasarath, the king of Kosala, and have come into the forest in obedience to our father’s command; Rama, the name of one brother, and Lakshman of the other. With us was my young and beautiful bride, the daughter of the king of Videha, But some demon here has stolen her away; and it is she, O BrAhman, whom we are trying to find. We have told you our affairs, tell us now your own story.” He recognized his lord and fell and clasped his feet with a joy, Uma, beyond all description. His body thrilled with emotion and all words failed his tongue, as he gazed upon the fashion of their ravishing disguise. At last he collected himself and burst forth into a hymn of praise, with great joy of heart, for he had found his lord. ‘T asked, sire, in my ignorance; but why should you ask, as though you were a mere man. Under the influence of your delusive power I wandered in error, and therefore I did not at once recognize my lord.
In the first place I was a bewildered dullard, ignorant and perverse of soul, and then my gracious Lord God himself led me astray.

sections.label: Doha 3
sections.name: सो अनन्य जाकें असि मति न टरइ हनुमंत

verses.sa:
जदपि नाथ बहु अवगुन मोरें ।
सेवक प्रभुहि परै जनि भोरें ॥
verses.tr:
jadapi nāth bahu avagun moreṃ
sevak prabhuhi parai jani bhoreṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नाथ जीव तव मायाँ मोहा ।
सो निस्तरइ तुम्हारेहिं छोहा ॥
verses.tr:
nāth jīv tav māyām̐ mohā
so nistarai tumhārehiṃ chohā

verses.sa:
ता पर मैं रघुबीर दोहाई ।
जानउँ नहिं कछु भजन उपाई ॥
verses.tr:
tā par maiṃ raghubīr dohāī
jānaum̐ nahiṃ kachu bhajan upāī

verses.sa:
सेवक सुत पति मातु भरोसें ।
रहइ असोच बनइ प्रभु पोसें ॥
verses.tr:
sevak sut pati mātu bharoseṃ
rahai asoc banai prabhu poseṃ

verses.sa:
अस कहि परेउ चरन अकुलाई ।
निज तनु प्रगटि प्रीति उर छाई ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi pareu caran akulāī
nij tanu pragaṭi prīti ur chāī

verses.sa:
तब रघुपति उठाइ उर लावा ।
निज लोचन जल सींचि जुड़ावा ॥
verses.tr:
tab raghupati uṭhāi ur lāvā
nij locan jal sīṃci jur̤āvā

verses.sa:
सुनु कपि जियँ मानसि जनि ऊना ।
तैं मम प्रिय लछिमन ते दूना ॥
verses.tr:
sunu kapi jiyam̐ mānasi jani ūnā
taiṃ mam priya lachiman te dūnā

verses.sa:
समदरसी मोहि कह सब कोऊ ।
सेवक प्रिय अनन्यगति सोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
samadarasī mohi kah sab koū
sevak priya ananyagati soū

verses.sa:
सो अनन्य जाकें असि मति न टरइ हनुमंत ।
मैं सेवक सचराचर रूप स्वामि भगवंत ॥
verses.tr:
so ananya jākeṃ asi mati na ṭarai hanumaṃt
maiṃ sevak sacarācar rūp svāmi bhagavaṃt
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Although, sire, my faults are many, yet a servant cannot anyhow be above his master. All created things are first fettered by your delusive power and then again set free by your grace Therefore ] make my cry to Raghubir, and know no other saving mode of prayer. As a servant has confidence in his master, or a child in its mother, so all dwell secure under the protection of the Lord.” So saying, he fell in much agitation at his feet, and the love that filled his soul showed itself in every part of his body. Then Raghupati raised him up and took him to his bosom, while his own eyes were flooded with tears of joy. ‘“ Hearken, O monkey; do not account yourself vile; you are second to Lakshman only in my affection; every one says that I have no respect of persons; any servant is beloved of me, and has a rank in heaven second to none.
For he, Hanuman, is second to none who never wavers in this faith, that he is the servant of the Lord God who is manifested in creation.”

sections.label: Doha 4
sections.name: तब हनुमंत उभय दिसि की सब कथा सुनाइ

verses.sa:
देखि पवन सुत पति अनुकूला ।
हृदयँ हरष बीती सब सूला ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi pavan sut pati anukūlā
hṛdayam̐ haraṣ bītī sab sūlā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नाथ सैल पर कपिपति रहई ।
सो सुग्रीव दास तव अहई ॥
verses.tr:
nāth sail par kapipati rahaī
so sugrīv dās tav ahaī

verses.sa:
तेहि सन नाथ मयत्री कीजे ।
दीन जानि तेहि अभय करीजे ॥
verses.tr:
tehi san nāth mayatrī kīje
dīn jāni tehi abhaya karīje

verses.sa:
सो सीता कर खोज कराइहि ।
जहँ तहँ मरकट कोटि पठाइहि ॥
verses.tr:
so sītā kar khoj karāihi
jaham̐ taham̐ marakaṭ koṭi paṭhāihi

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि सकल कथा समुझाई ।
लिए दुऔ जन पीठि चढ़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi sakal kathā samujhāī
lie duau jan pīṭhi car̤hāī

verses.sa:
जब सुग्रीवँ राम कहुँ देखा ।
अतिसय जन्म धन्य करि लेखा ॥
verses.tr:
jab sugrīvam̐ rām kahum̐ dekhā
atisaya janm dhanya kari lekhā

verses.sa:
सादर मिलेउ नाइ पद माथा ।
भैंटेउ अनुज सहित रघुनाथा ॥
verses.tr:
sādar mileu nāi pad māthā
bhaiṃṭeu anuj sahit raghunāthā

verses.sa:
कपि कर मन बिचार एहि रीती ।
करिहहिं बिधि मो सन ए प्रीती ॥
verses.tr:
kapi kar man bicār ehi rītī
karihahiṃ bidhi mo san e prītī

verses.sa: तब हनुमंत उभय दिसि की सब कथा सुनाइ ॥
verses.tr: tab hanumaṃt ubhaya disi kī sab kathā sunāi
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: पावक साखी देइ करि जोरी प्रीती दृढ़ाइ ॥
verses.tr: pāvak sākhī dei kari jorī prītī dṛr̤hāi

trans: . When the Son of the Wind (t.e, Hanuman) saw his lord so gracious, he rejoiced at heart, and every anxiety was atan end. “The king of the monkeys, sire, lives on this rock, Sugriva by name, a servant of yours. In return for his submission you should make friends with him and set his mind at rest. He will have Sita tracked; for he will despatch millions of monkeys io every direction.” In this manner he told them all the particulars and took them both with him and gave them stools to sit upon. When Sugriva saw Rama, he thought ita great blessing to have been born. He reverentially advanced to meet him and bowed his head at his feet; and Raghunath and his brother returned his courtesy. The monkey’s mind was occupied with this thought, ‘If God would only give me such allies!’ Dohd 4.
Hanuman then explained the circumstances of both sides; holy fire was made a witness, and a firm alliance concluded.

sections.label: Doha 5
sections.name: सखा बचन सुनि हरषे कृपासिधु बलसींव

verses.sa:
कीन्ही प्रीति कछु बीच न राखा ।
लछमिन राम चरित सब भाषा ॥
verses.tr:
kīnhī prīti kachu bīc na rākhā
lachamin rām carit sab bhāṣā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कह सुग्रीव नयन भरि बारी ।
मिलिहि नाथ मिथिलेसकुमारी ॥
verses.tr:
kah sugrīv nayan bhari bārī
milihi nāth mithilesakumārī

verses.sa:
मंत्रिन्ह सहित इहाँ एक बारा ।
बैठ रहेउँ मैं करत बिचारा ॥
verses.tr:
maṃtrinh sahit ihām̐ ek bārā
baiṭh raheum̐ maiṃ karat bicārā

verses.sa:
गगन पंथ देखी मैं जाता ।
परबस परी बहुत बिलपाता ॥
verses.tr:
gagan paṃth dekhī maiṃ jātā
parabas parī bahut bilapātā

verses.sa:
राम राम हा राम पुकारी ।
हमहि देखि दीन्हेउ पट डारी ॥
verses.tr:
rām rām hā rām pukārī
hamahi dekhi dīnheu paṭ ḍārī

verses.sa:
मागा राम तुरत तेहिं दीन्हा ।
पट उर लाइ सोच अति कीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
māgā rām turat tehiṃ dīnhā
paṭ ur lāi soc ati kīnhā

verses.sa:
कह सुग्रीव सुनहु रघुबीरा ।
तजहु सोच मन आनहु धीरा ॥
verses.tr:
kah sugrīv sunahu raghubīrā
tajahu soc man ānahu dhīrā

verses.sa:
सब प्रकार करिहउँ सेवकाई ।
जेहि बिधि मिलिहि जानकी आई ॥
verses.tr:
sab prakār karihaum̐ sevakāī
jehi bidhi milihi jānakī āī

verses.sa:
सखा बचन सुनि हरषे कृपासिधु बलसींव ।
कारन कवन बसहु बन मोहि कहहु सुग्रीव ॥
verses.tr:
sakhā bacan suni haraṣe kṛpāsidhu balasīṃv
kāran kavan basahu ban mohi kahahu sugrīv
verses.head: दोहा

trans: When the alliance had been concluded, nothing was kept in reserve; Rama and Lakshman told all their adventures. Sugriva’s eyes were full of tears as he replied— “The daughter of the king of Mithila will be recovered. One day when I was sitting here with my ministers deep in thought, I saw some one flying through the air, with a woman in his power, who was weeping piteously and orying ‘Rama, Rama, O my Rama!’ When she saw me, she drop-

d her scarf.” Rama at once asked for it; he gave it him; Fe pressed the scarf to his bosom in the deepest distress. Said Sugriva: “Hearken, Raghubir; be not so distressed; take courage. I willdoin my power to serve you and recover Janaki.”
The All-merciful and Almighty rejoiced to hear his friend’s speech. “Tell me, Sugriva, the reason why you are living in this forest.”
My lord, BAli and I are two brothers; our mutual
love was past all telling. The son of Maya, MayAvi by

sections.label: Doha 6
sections.name: सुनु सुग्रीव मारिहउँ बालिहि एकहिं बान

verses.sa:
नात बालि अरु मैं द्वौ भाई ।
प्रीति रही कछु बरनि न जाई ॥
verses.tr:
nāt bāli aru maiṃ dvau bhāī
prīti rahī kachu barani na jāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मय सुत मायावी तेहि नाऊँ ।
आवा सो प्रभु हमरें गाऊँ ॥
verses.tr:
maya sut māyāvī tehi nāūm̐
āvā so prabhu hamareṃ gāūm̐

verses.sa:
अर्ध राति पुर द्वार पुकारा ।
बाली रिपु बल सहै न पारा ॥
verses.tr:
ardh rāti pur dvār pukārā
bālī ripu bal sahai na pārā

verses.sa:
धावा बालि देखि सो भागा ।
मैं पुनि गयउँ बंधु सँग लागा ॥
verses.tr:
dhāvā bāli dekhi so bhāgā
maiṃ puni gayaum̐ baṃdhu sam̐g lāgā

verses.sa:
गिरिबर गुहाँ पैठ सो जाई ।
तब बालीं मोहि कहा बुझाई ॥
verses.tr:
giribar guhām̐ paiṭh so jāī
tab bālīṃ mohi kahā bujhāī

verses.sa:
परिखेसु मोहि एक पखवारा ।
नहिं आवौं तब जानेसु मारा ॥
verses.tr:
parikhesu mohi ek pakhavārā
nahiṃ āvauṃ tab jānesu mārā

verses.sa:
मास दिवस तहँ रहेउँ खरारी ।
निसरी रुधिर धार तहँ भारी ॥
verses.tr:
mās divas taham̐ raheum̐ kharārī
nisarī rudhir dhār taham̐ bhārī

verses.sa:
बालि हतेसि मोहि मारिहि आई ।
सिला देइ तहँ चलेउँ पराई ॥
verses.tr:
bāli hatesi mohi mārihi āī
silā dei taham̐ caleum̐ parāī

verses.sa:
मंत्रिन्ह पुर देखा बिनु साईं ।
दीन्हेउ मोहि राज बरिआई ॥
verses.tr:
maṃtrinh pur dekhā binu sāīṃ
dīnheu mohi rāj bariāī

verses.sa:
बालि ताहि मारि गृह आवा ।
देखि मोहि जियँ भेद बढ़ावा ॥
verses.tr:
bāli tāhi māri gṛh āvā
dekhi mohi jiyam̐ bhed bar̤hāvā

verses.sa:
रिपु सम मोहि मारेसि अति भारी ।
हरि लीन्हेसि सर्बसु अरु नारी ॥
verses.tr:
ripu sam mohi māresi ati bhārī
hari līnhesi sarbasu aru nārī

verses.sa:
ताकें भय रघुबीर कृपाला ।
सकल भुवन मैं फिरेउँ बिहाला ॥
verses.tr:
tākeṃ bhaya raghubīr kṛpālā
sakal bhuvan maiṃ phireum̐ bihālā

verses.sa:
इहाँ साप बस आवत नाहीं ।
तदपि सभीत रहउँ मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
ihām̐ sāp bas āvat nāhīṃ
tadapi sabhīt rahaum̐ man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
सुनि सेवक दुख दीनदयाला ।
फरकि उठीं द्वै भुजा बिसाला ॥
verses.tr:
suni sevak dukh dīnadayālā
pharaki uṭhīṃ dvai bhujā bisālā

verses.sa:
सुनु सुग्रीव मारिहउँ बालिहि एकहिं बान ।
ब्रम्ह रुद्र सरनागत गएँ न उबरिहिं प्रान ॥
verses.tr:
sunu sugrīv mārihaum̐ bālihi ekahiṃ bān
bramh rudr saranāgat gaem̐ na ubarihiṃ prān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: name came to our town. In the middle of the night he shouted at the city-gate. B^li endures no enemy to set him at defiance and sallied forth. Seeing this he fled. Now I too accompanied my brother, and when he had gone into one of the caves of the mountain, Bill said to me: • Wait for me a fortnight, and if I do not come then, conclude that I have been killed. I stayed there a whole month, Khardri; a tremendous stream of blood then flowed out; I made sure that Bali had been defeated and that the enemy would come and kill me too. I therefore closed the mouth of tlie cave with a rock and fled away. When the ministers of state saw the city without a master, they forced the government upon me, whether I would or no. When Bali, who had slain the foe, came home and saw me, he was greatly set against me and gave me a severe beating, as he would an enemy, and took from me everything that I had, together with my wife. For fear of him, 0 merciful Raghubir, I wander forlorn all over the world. The curse^
prevents him from coming here, and yet I am ill at ease in mind.” When the friend of the suppliant heard of his servant's troubles, his two mighty arms were uplifted with a convalsive motion.
“Hearken, Sugriva; I will slay Bali with a single arrow; though he take refuge with Brahma even, or Rudra, he shall not escape with his life.

sections.label: Doha 7
sections.name: कह बालि सुनु भीरु प्रिय समदरसी रघुनाथ

verses.sa:
जे न मित्र दुख होहिं दुखारी ।
तिन्हहि बिलोकत पातक भारी ॥
verses.tr:
je na mitr dukh hohiṃ dukhārī
tinhahi bilokat pātak bhārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
निज दुख गिरि सम रज करि जाना ।
मित्रक दुख रज मेरु समाना ॥
verses.tr:
nij dukh giri sam raj kari jānā
mitrak dukh raj meru samānā

verses.sa:
जिन्ह कें असि मति सहज न आई ।
ते सठ कत हठि करत मिताई ॥
verses.tr:
jinh keṃ asi mati sahaj na āī
te saṭh kat haṭhi karat mitāī

verses.sa:
कुपथ निवारि सुपंथ चलावा ।
गुन प्रगटे अवगुनन्हि दुरावा ॥
verses.tr:
kupath nivāri supaṃth calāvā
gun pragaṭe avagunanhi durāvā

verses.sa:
देत लेत मन संक न धरई ।
बल अनुमान सदा हित करई ॥
verses.tr:
det let man saṃk na dharaī
bal anumān sadā hit karaī

verses.sa:
बिपति काल कर सतगुन नेहा ।
श्रुति कह संत मित्र गुन एहा ॥
verses.tr:
bipati kāl kar satagun nehā
śruti kah saṃt mitr gun ehā

verses.sa:
आगें कह मृदु बचन बनाई ।
पाछें अनहित मन कुटिलाई ॥
verses.tr:
āgeṃ kah mṛdu bacan banāī
pācheṃ anahit man kuṭilāī

verses.sa:
जा कर चित अहि गति सम भाई ।
अस कुमित्र परिहरेहि भलाई ॥
verses.tr:
jā kar cit ahi gati sam bhāī
as kumitr pariharehi bhalāī

verses.sa:
सेवक सठ नृप कृपन कुनारी ।
कपटी मित्र सूल सम चारी ॥
verses.tr:
sevak saṭh nṛp kṛpan kunārī
kapaṭī mitr sūl sam cārī

verses.sa:
सखा सोच त्यागहु बल मोरें ।
सब बिधि घटब काज मैं तोरें ॥
verses.tr:
sakhā soc tyāgahu bal moreṃ
sab bidhi ghaṭab kāj maiṃ toreṃ

verses.sa:
कह सुग्रीव सुनहु रघुबीरा ।
बालि महाबल अति रनधीरा ॥
verses.tr:
kah sugrīv sunahu raghubīrā
bāli mahābal ati ranadhīrā

verses.sa:
दुंदुभी अस्थि ताल देखराए ।
बिनु प्रयास रघुनाथ ढहाए ॥
verses.tr:
duṃdubhī asthi tāl dekharāe
binu prayās raghunāth ḍhahāe

verses.sa:
देखि अमित बल बाढ़ी प्रीती ।
बालि बधब इन्ह भइ परतीती ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi amit bal bār̤hī prītī
bāli badhab inh bhai paratītī

verses.sa:
बार बार नावइ पद सीसा ।
प्रभुहि जानि मन हरष कपीसा ॥
verses.tr:
bār bār nāvai pad sīsā
prabhuhi jāni man haraṣ kapīsā

verses.sa:
उपजा ग्यान बचन तब बोला ।
नाथ कृपाँ मन भयउ अलोला ॥
verses.tr:
upajā gyān bacan tab bolā
nāth kṛpām̐ man bhayau alolā

verses.sa:
सुख संपति परिवार बड़ाई ।
सब परिहरि करिहउँ सेवकाई ॥
verses.tr:
sukh saṃpati parivār bar̤āī
sab parihari karihaum̐ sevakāī

verses.sa:
ए सब रामभगति के बाधक ।
कहहिं संत तब पद अवराधक ॥
verses.tr:
e sab rāmabhagati ke bādhak
kahahiṃ saṃt tab pad avarādhak

verses.sa:
सत्रु मित्र सुख दुख जग माहीं ।
माया कृत परमारथ नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
satru mitr sukh dukh jag māhīṃ
māyā kṛt paramārath nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
बालि परम हित जासु प्रसादा ।
मिलेहु राम तुम्ह समन बिषादा ॥
verses.tr:
bāli param hit jāsu prasādā
milehu rām tumh saman biṣādā

verses.sa:
सपनें जेहि सन होइ लराई ।
जागें समुझत मन सकुचाई ॥
verses.tr:
sapaneṃ jehi san hoi larāī
jāgeṃ samujhat man sakucāī

verses.sa:
अब प्रभु कृपा करहु एहि भाँती ।
सब तजि भजनु करौं दिन राती ॥
verses.tr:
ab prabhu kṛpā karahu ehi bhām̐tī
sab taji bhajanu karauṃ din rātī

verses.sa:
सुनि बिराग संजुत कपि बानी ।
बोले बिहँसि रामु धनुपानी ॥
verses.tr:
suni birāg saṃjut kapi bānī
bole biham̐si rāmu dhanupānī

verses.sa:
जो कछु कहेहु सत्य सब सोई ।
सखा बचन मम मृषा न होई ॥
verses.tr:
jo kachu kahehu satya sab soī
sakhā bacan mam mṛṣā na hoī

verses.sa:
नट मरकट इव सबहि नचावत ।
रामु खगेस बेद अस गावत ॥
verses.tr:
naṭ marakaṭ iv sabahi nacāvat
rāmu khages bed as gāvat

verses.sa:
लै सुग्रीव संग रघुनाथा ।
चले चाप सायक गहि हाथा ॥
verses.tr:
lai sugrīv saṃg raghunāthā
cale cāp sāyak gahi hāthā

verses.sa:
तब रघुपति सुग्रीव पठावा ।
गर्जेसि जाइ निकट बल पावा ॥
verses.tr:
tab raghupati sugrīv paṭhāvā
garjesi jāi nikaṭ bal pāvā

verses.sa:
सुनत बालि क्रोधातुर धावा ।
गहि कर चरन नारि समुझावा ॥
verses.tr:
sunat bāli krodhātur dhāvā
gahi kar caran nāri samujhāvā

verses.sa:
सुनु पति जिन्हहि मिलेउ सुग्रीवा ।
ते द्वौ बंधु तेज बल सींवा ॥
verses.tr:
sunu pati jinhahi mileu sugrīvā
te dvau baṃdhu tej bal sīṃvā

verses.sa:
कोसलेस सुत लछिमन रामा ।
कालहु जीति सकहिं संग्रामा ॥
verses.tr:
kosales sut lachiman rāmā
kālahu jīti sakahiṃ saṃgrāmā

verses.sa:
कह बालि सुनु भीरु प्रिय समदरसी रघुनाथ ।
जौं कदाचि मोहि मारहिं तौ पुनि होउँ सनाथ ॥
verses.tr:
kah bāli sunu bhīru priya samadarasī raghunāth
jauṃ kadāci mohi mārahiṃ tau puni houm̐ sanāth
verses.head: दोहा

trans: They, who are not distressed at the sight of a friend’s distress, are guilty of grievous sin. They, who do not think it the most natural thing possible to regard as & mere grain of sand their own mountain-like troubles, while a friend’s trouble, though really no bigger than @ grain of sand, seems to them as weighty as mount Meru; such men are churls, upon whom it is useless to press friendship. To restrain from evil paths and to direct in the path of virtue; to publish all good qualities and conceal the bad; to giveand take without any distrust of mind; to be always ready to assist with all one’s power, and, in time of misfortune to be a hundred times more affectionate than ever; such the scriptures declare to be the properties of a true friend. But one who speaks you fairly to your face, but behind your back is an enemy in the viciousness of his soul, whose mind, brother, is as tortaous as the movements of a snake, such a inan is a bad. friend, whom it is well to let alone. A dishonest servant, a miserly king, a false wife, and a treacherous friend, are four things as bad as the stake. Cease to distress yourself, friend; I will pat forthallmy strength to do your business for you.” Said Sugriva: “Hearken, Raghubir; Bali is very strong and most resolute in battle,” and he showed him Dundn-bhi’s bones and the palm-trees. Without an effort, Raghubir tossed them away. At this exhibition of boundless strength the affection of the monkey king was increased and he made sure of killing Bali. Again and again he bowed his head at his feet, in the greatest delight, knowing him to be the Lord. Knowledge sprung up in his soul, and he spoke and said: “By my lord’s favour my mind is set at rest; I will abandon pleasure, fortune, home, grandeur and all, to do you service; for all these things are hindrances to faith in RfimA, as the saints declare who are devoted to the worship of your feet. All the friends and enemies, joys and sorrows of the world, effects of delusion, and are not enternal reslities. Baliis my greatest friend, by whose favour I have met you, O Rama, destroyer of all sorrow; as when a man dreams that he has been fighting some one, and on waking and coming to his senses is ashamed of his illusion. Now, my lord, do me this favour, that I may leave all and worship you, night and day.” When Rama heard the monkey’s devout speech, he smiled and said, with his bow in his hand: ‘Whatever I have said is all true; my words, friend, cannot fail.” O Gariir, Rama, as the scriptures say, is the juggler who makes us all dance like so many monkeys. Sugriva then took Raghunath away with him, who went with bow and arrows in hand. Afterwards he sent Sugriva on ahead, who went up close and roared with all his might. Bali on hearing him, sprang up in a fury, but his wife clasped his feet in her hands and warned him;: “Hearken, my lord, Sugriva’s allies are two brothers of unapproachable majesty and might, the sons of the king of Kosala, Lakshman and Rama, who would conquer in battle even Death himself.”
Said Bali: “Hearken, timorous dame; Raghunath is kind and the same to all; even if he kill me, he will still be my lord.”

sections.label: Doha 8
sections.name: बहु छल बल सुग्रीव कर हियँ हारा भय मानि

verses.sa:
अस कहि चला महा अभिमानी ।
तृन समान सुग्रीवहि जानी ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi calā mahā abhimānī
tṛn samān sugrīvahi jānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भिरे उभौ बाली अति तर्जा ।
मुठिका मारि महाधुनि गर्जा ॥
verses.tr:
bhire ubhau bālī ati tarjā
muṭhikā māri mahādhuni garjā

verses.sa:
तब सुग्रीव बिकल होइ भागा ।
मुष्टि प्रहार बज्र सम लागा ॥
verses.tr:
tab sugrīv bikal hoi bhāgā
muṣṭi prahār bajr sam lāgā

verses.sa:
मैं जो कहा रघुबीर कृपाला ।
बंधु न होइ मोर यह काला ॥
verses.tr:
maiṃ jo kahā raghubīr kṛpālā
baṃdhu na hoi mor yah kālā

verses.sa:
एकरूप तुम्ह भ्राता दोऊ ।
तेहि भ्रम तें नहिं मारेउँ सोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
ekarūp tumh bhrātā doū
tehi bhram teṃ nahiṃ māreum̐ soū

verses.sa:
कर परसा सुग्रीव सरीरा ।
तनु भा कुलिस गई सब पीरा ॥
verses.tr:
kar parasā sugrīv sarīrā
tanu bhā kulis gaī sab pīrā

verses.sa:
मेली कंठ सुमन कै माला ।
पठवा पुनि बल देइ बिसाला ॥
verses.tr:
melī kaṃṭh suman kai mālā
paṭhavā puni bal dei bisālā

verses.sa:
पुनि नाना बिधि भई लराई ।
बिटप ओट देखहिं रघुराई ॥
verses.tr:
puni nānā bidhi bhaī larāī
biṭap oṭ dekhahiṃ raghurāī

verses.sa:
बहु छल बल सुग्रीव कर हियँ हारा भय मानि ।
मारा बालि राम तब हृदय माझ सर तानि ॥
verses.tr:
bahu chal bal sugrīv kar hiyam̐ hārā bhaya māni
mārā bāli rām tab hṛdaya mājh sar tāni
verses.head: दोहा

trans: So sayiug, he sallied forth in all his pride, thinking no more of Sugriva than of a blade of grass. The two joined combat; and Bali with a furious leap struck him a blow with his fist, which resounded like a clap of thunder. Sugriva at once fled in dismay; the stroke of his fist had fallen upon him as a bolt from heaven. ‘What did I say, O merciful Raghubir; this is no brother of mine but Death himself.”

“You two brothers are so much alike that for fear of mistake I did not shoot him.” He then stroked Sugriva’s body with his hands and his frame became as of adamant, and all his pain was gone. Next he put on his neck a wreath of flowers and sent him back with a large increase of strength. Again they fought in every kind of way, while Rama watched them from behind a tree.
When Sugriva had tried every trick and put forth all his strength and had given up in despair, Rama drew an arrow and struck Bali in the heart.

sections.label: Doha 9
sections.name: सुनहु राम स्वामी सन चल न चातुरी मोरि

verses.sa:
परा बिकल महि सर के लागें ।
पुनि उठि बैठ देखि प्रभु आगें ॥
verses.tr:
parā bikal mahi sar ke lāgeṃ
puni uṭhi baiṭh dekhi prabhu āgeṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
स्याम गात सिर जटा बनाएँ ।
अरुन नयन सर चाप चढ़ाएँ ॥
verses.tr:
syām gāt sir jaṭā banāem̐
arun nayan sar cāp car̤hāem̐

verses.sa:
पुनि पुनि चितइ चरन चित दीन्हा ।
सुफल जन्म माना प्रभु चीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
puni puni citai caran cit dīnhā
suphal janm mānā prabhu cīnhā

verses.sa:
हृदयँ प्रीति मुख बचन कठोरा ।
बोला चितइ राम की ओरा ॥
verses.tr:
hṛdayam̐ prīti mukh bacan kaṭhorā
bolā citai rām kī orā

verses.sa:
धर्म हेतु अवतरेहु गोसाई ।
मारेहु मोहि ब्याध की नाई ॥
verses.tr:
dharm hetu avatarehu gosāī
mārehu mohi byādh kī nāī

verses.sa:
मैं बैरी सुग्रीव पिआरा ।
अवगुन कबन नाथ मोहि मारा ॥
verses.tr:
maiṃ bairī sugrīv piārā
avagun kaban nāth mohi mārā

verses.sa:
अनुज बधू भगिनी सुत नारी ।
सुनु सठ कन्या सम ए चारी ॥
verses.tr:
anuj badhū bhaginī sut nārī
sunu saṭh kanyā sam e cārī

verses.sa:
इन्हहि कुद्दष्टि बिलोकइ जोई ।
ताहि बधें कछु पाप न होई ॥
verses.tr:
inhahi kuddaṣṭi bilokai joī
tāhi badheṃ kachu pāp na hoī

verses.sa:
मुढ़ तोहि अतिसय अभिमाना ।
नारि सिखावन करसि न काना ॥
verses.tr:
mur̤h tohi atisaya abhimānā
nāri sikhāvan karasi na kānā

verses.sa:
मम भुज बल आश्रित तेहि जानी ।
मारा चहसि अधम अभिमानी ॥
verses.tr:
mam bhuj bal āśrit tehi jānī
mārā cahasi adham abhimānī

verses.sa:
सुनहु राम स्वामी सन चल न चातुरी मोरि ।
प्रभु अजहूँ मैं पापी अंतकाल गति तोरि ॥
verses.tr:
sunahu rām svāmī san cal na cāturī mori
prabhu ajahūm̐ maiṃ pāpī aṃtakāl gati tori
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Struck by the shaft, he fell in dismay to the ground. Again he sat up and saw the Lord standing before him, dark of hue, with his hair fastened up in a knot on his head, and his eyes inflamed as they were when he fitted the arrow to bowstring. Again and again as he gazed upon him, he laid his soul at his feet and accounted his life blessed: for he recognized his lord. Though his heart was full of affection, the words of his mouth were harsh, as he look. ed towards Rama and said: ‘You have become incarnate, sire, for the advancement of religion, and yet you take my life as a huntsman would that of a wild beast. I, forsooth, am an enemy and Sugriva afrignd; yet for what fault have you killed me my lord?” “Hearken, wretch; a younger brother’s wife, a sister, a daughter-in-law and an. unwedded maid are all alike: whoever looks upon one of them with an evil eye may be slain without any sin. Fool], in your extravagant pride you paid no heed to your wife’s warning. You knew that he had taken refuge under the might of my arm, and yet in your wicked pride you wished to kill] him.”
- Hearken Rama; I dealt craftily with my lord; to-day, guilty asI am, I obtain, sire, at my death a place in heaven.” Chaupdi.

sections.label: Doha 10
sections.name: राम चरन दृढ़ प्रीति करि बालि कीन्ह तनु त्याग

verses.sa:
सुनत राम अति कोमल बानी ।
बालि सीस परसेउ निज पानी ॥
verses.tr:
sunat rām ati komal bānī
bāli sīs paraseu nij pānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
अचल करौं तनु राखहु प्राना ।
बालि कहा सुनु कृपानिधाना ॥
verses.tr:
acal karauṃ tanu rākhahu prānā
bāli kahā sunu kṛpānidhānā

verses.sa:
जन्म जन्म मुनि जतनु कराहीं ।
अंत राम कहि आवत नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
janm janm muni jatanu karāhīṃ
aṃt rām kahi āvat nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
जासु नाम बल संकर कासी ।
देत सबहि सम गति अविनासी ॥
verses.tr:
jāsu nām bal saṃkar kāsī
det sabahi sam gati avināsī

verses.sa:
मम लोचन गोचर सोइ आवा ।
बहुरि कि प्रभु अस बनिहि बनावा ॥
verses.tr:
mam locan gocar soi āvā
bahuri ki prabhu as banihi banāvā

verses.sa:
सो नयन गोचर जासु गुन नित नेति कहि श्रुति गावहीं ।
जिति पवन मन गो निरस करि मुनि ध्यान कबहुँक पावहीं ॥
verses.tr:
so nayan gocar jāsu gun nit neti kahi śruti gāvahīṃ
jiti pavan man go niras kari muni dhyān kabahum̐k pāvahīṃ
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
मोहि जानि अति अभिमान बस प्रभु कहेउ राखु सरीरही ।
अस कवन सठ हठि काटि सुरतरु बारि करिहि बबूरही ॥
verses.tr:
mohi jāni ati abhimān bas prabhu kaheu rākhu sarīrahī
as kavan saṭh haṭhi kāṭi surataru bāri karihi babūrahī

verses.sa:
अब नाथ करि करुना बिलोकहु देहु जो बर मागऊँ ।
जेहिं जोनि जन्मौं कर्म बस तहँ राम पद अनुरागऊँ ॥
verses.tr:
ab nāth kari karunā bilokahu dehu jo bar māgaūm̐
jehiṃ joni janmauṃ karm bas taham̐ rām pad anurāgaūm̐

verses.sa:
यह तनय मम सम बिनय बल कल्यानप्रद प्रभु लीजिऐ ।
गहि बाहँ सुर नर नाह आपन दास अंगद कीजिऐ ॥
verses.tr:
yah tanaya mam sam binaya bal kalyānaprad prabhu lījiai
gahi bāham̐ sur nar nāh āpan dās aṃgad kījiai

verses.sa:
राम चरन दृढ़ प्रीति करि बालि कीन्ह तनु त्याग ।
सुमन माल जिमि कंठ ते गिरत न जानइ नाग ॥
verses.tr:
rām caran dṛr̤h prīti kari bāli kīnh tanu tyāg
suman māl jimi kaṃṭh te girat na jānai nāg
verses.head: दोहा

trans: When Rama heard this most tender speech, he touched Bali's head with his hands: ‘I restore the soundness of your body; retain your life.” Said Bali; * Hearken, Allmerciful; the saints are born again and again and labour throughout their life, and yet even to the last Rama never comes near them. But he, the everlasting, by the virtue of whose name Sankara at Kesi bestows heaven upon all alike, has come in visible form before my very eyes; can I ever, my lord, have such a chance again?

He has become visible to my eyes, whose praises the scriptures are all unequal to declare, to whom scarcely the saints attain after profound contemplation accompanied by laborious suppression of the breath!, abstraction of soul, and control of the senses. Seeing me the victim of excessive pride, the Lord has told me toretain my body. But who would be such a fool asto insist upon cutting down the tree of paradise and watering a wild babul tree Now, my lord, look upon me with compassion and grant me the boon I beg; whatever the womb, in which it be my fate to

‘be born, may I ever cherish a special devotion to the feet of RAma. O my lord, take this my son Angad and grant him like discretion, power and prosperity; grasp him by the hand. Oking of gods and men, and make him your servant.”
After making a fervent act of devotion to Rama's feet, Bali's soul left the body; as pluoidly as when a wreath of flowers drops from an elephant’s neck without his knowing it;

sections.label: Doha 11
sections.name: लछिमन तुरत बोलाए पुरजन बिप्र समाज

verses.sa:
राम बालि निज धाम पठावा ।
नगर लोग सब ब्याकुल धावा ॥
verses.tr:
rām bāli nij dhām paṭhāvā
nagar log sab byākul dhāvā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नाना बिधि बिलाप कर तारा ।
छूटे केस न देह सँभारा ॥
verses.tr:
nānā bidhi bilāp kar tārā
chūṭe kes na deh sam̐bhārā

verses.sa:
तारा बिकल देखि रघुराया ।
दीन्ह ग्यान हरि लीन्ही माया ॥
verses.tr:
tārā bikal dekhi raghurāyā
dīnh gyān hari līnhī māyā

verses.sa:
छिति जल पावक गगन समीरा ।
पंच रचित अति अधम सरीरा ॥
verses.tr:
chiti jal pāvak gagan samīrā
paṃc racit ati adham sarīrā

verses.sa:
प्रगट सो तनु तव आगें सोवा ।
जीव नित्य केहि लगि तुम्ह रोवा ॥
verses.tr:
pragaṭ so tanu tav āgeṃ sovā
jīv nitya kehi lagi tumh rovā

verses.sa:
उपजा ग्यान चरन तब लागी ।
लीन्हेसि परम भगति बर मागी ॥
verses.tr:
upajā gyān caran tab lāgī
līnhesi param bhagati bar māgī

verses.sa:
उमा दारु जोषित की नाई ।
सबहि नचावत रामु गोसाई ॥
verses.tr:
umā dāru joṣit kī nāī
sabahi nacāvat rāmu gosāī

verses.sa:
तब सुग्रीवहि आयसु दीन्हा ।
मृतक कर्म बिधिबत सब कीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
tab sugrīvahi āyasu dīnhā
mṛtak karm bidhibat sab kīnhā

verses.sa:
राम कहा अनुजहि समुझाई ।
राज देहु सुग्रीवहि जाई ॥
verses.tr:
rām kahā anujahi samujhāī
rāj dehu sugrīvahi jāī

verses.sa:
रघुपति चरन नाइ करि माथा ।
चले सकल प्रेरित रघुनाथा ॥
verses.tr:
raghupati caran nāi kari māthā
cale sakal prerit raghunāthā

verses.sa:
लछिमन तुरत बोलाए पुरजन बिप्र समाज ।
राजु दीन्ह सुग्रीव कहँ अंगद कहँ जुबराज ॥
verses.tr:
lachiman turat bolāe purajan bipr samāj
rāju dīnh sugrīv kaham̐ aṃgad kaham̐ jubarāj
verses.head: दोहा

trans: And Rama dismissed him to his own heavenly mansion. All the people of the city ran together in dismay and Tere with dishovelled hair and tottering frame broke out into wild lamentation. When Raghurdi saw her distress, he imparted to her wisdom and dispersed her delusion. ‘The body, which is composed of the elements, earth, water, fire, air and ether“, isof no value. The mortal frame, which

you see before you, sleeps; but the soul is eternal; why a teem then do you weep?” True understanding sprung up dn her mind; she embraced his feet and received a boon that she asked, a perfect faith, O, Uma, the lord Rama dances us all up and down like so many puppets. Then he gave orders to Sugriva and he performed all the funeral rites with due ceremony. Rama next directed his brother to go and celebrate Sugriva’s installation. He bowed his head at Raghupati’s feet and went forth, he and all whom Rama had commissioned to accompany him.
Lakshman immediately summoned the citizens and the council of Brahmans, and invested Sugriva with the sovereignty and appointed Angad Prince Imperial.

sections.label: Doha 12
sections.name: प्रथमहिं देवन्ह गिरि गुहा राखेउ रुचिर बनाइ

verses.sa:
उमा राम सम हित जग माहीं ।
गुरु पितु मातु बंधु प्रभु नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
umā rām sam hit jag māhīṃ
guru pitu mātu baṃdhu prabhu nāhīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुर नर मुनि सब कै यह रीती ।
स्वारथ लागि करहिं सब प्रीती ॥
verses.tr:
sur nar muni sab kai yah rītī
svārath lāgi karahiṃ sab prītī

verses.sa:
बालि त्रास ब्याकुल दिन राती ।
तन बहु ब्रन चिंताँ जर छाती ॥
verses.tr:
bāli trās byākul din rātī
tan bahu bran ciṃtām̐ jar chātī

verses.sa:
सोइ सुग्रीव कीन्ह कपिराऊ ।
अति कृपाल रघुबीर सुभाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
soi sugrīv kīnh kapirāū
ati kṛpāl raghubīr subhāū

verses.sa:
जानतहुँ अस प्रभु परिहरहीं ।
काहे न बिपति जाल नर परहीं ॥
verses.tr:
jānatahum̐ as prabhu pariharahīṃ
kāhe na bipati jāl nar parahīṃ

verses.sa:
पुनि सुग्रीवहि लीन्ह बोलाई ।
बहु प्रकार नृपनीति सिखाई ॥
verses.tr:
puni sugrīvahi līnh bolāī
bahu prakār nṛpanīti sikhāī

verses.sa:
कह प्रभु सुनु सुग्रीव हरीसा ।
पुर न जाउँ दस चारि बरीसा ॥
verses.tr:
kah prabhu sunu sugrīv harīsā
pur na jāum̐ das cāri barīsā

verses.sa:
गत ग्रीषम बरषा रितु आई ।
रहिहउँ निकट सैल पर छाई ॥
verses.tr:
gat grīṣam baraṣā ritu āī
rahihaum̐ nikaṭ sail par chāī

verses.sa:
अंगद सहित करहु तुम्ह राजू ।
संतत हृदय धरेहु मम काजू ॥
verses.tr:
aṃgad sahit karahu tumh rājū
saṃtat hṛdaya dharehu mam kājū

verses.sa:
जब सुग्रीव भवन फिरि आए ।
रामु प्रबरषन गिरि पर छाए ॥
verses.tr:
jab sugrīv bhavan phiri āe
rāmu prabaraṣan giri par chāe

verses.sa:
प्रथमहिं देवन्ह गिरि गुहा राखेउ रुचिर बनाइ ।
राम कृपानिधि कछु दिन बास करहिंगे आइ ॥
verses.tr:
prathamahiṃ devanh giri guhā rākheu rucir banāi
rām kṛpānidhi kachu din bās karahiṃge āi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: O, Uma, there is no such friend as Rama in the world, neither guru, nor father, nor mother, nor kinsman, nor lord. It is the way with all other gods, men and saints, to make friends for selfish purposes; but the generous Raghubir, from mere natural kindness, made Sugriva king of the monkeys, when he was trembling all the day and all night in such fear of Bali that there was no colour left in his face and his heart was burnt up with anxiety. I know this, that any man, who deserts such a lord, must needs be caught in the meshes of calamity. Rama then sent for Sugriva and instructed him inall the principles of statecraft, and added: “Hearken, Sugriva, lord of the monkey race; I may not eutera city for fourteen years. The hot weather is now over and the rains have set io. I will encamp on the hills close by. Do you with Angad reign in royal state; but remain ever mindful of my interests.” Sugriva then returned to the palace, while Rama remained in camp on mount Bravarshana.
The gods had beforehand made and kept for hima charming cave in the mountain, knowing that the all-merciful Rama would come and stay there for some days,

sections.label: Doha 13
sections.name: लछिमन देखु मोर गन नाचत बारिद पैखि

verses.sa:
सुंदर बन कुसुमित अति सोभा ।
गुंजत मधुप निकर मधु लोभा ॥
verses.tr:
suṃdar ban kusumit ati sobhā
guṃjat madhup nikar madhu lobhā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कंद मूल फल पत्र सुहाए ।
भए बहुत जब ते प्रभु आए ॥
verses.tr:
kaṃd mūl phal patr suhāe
bhae bahut jab te prabhu āe

verses.sa:
देखि मनोहर सैल अनूपा ।
रहे तहँ अनुज सहित सुरभूपा ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi manohar sail anūpā
rahe taham̐ anuj sahit surabhūpā

verses.sa:
मधुकर खग मृग तनु धरि देवा ।
करहिं सिद्ध मुनि प्रभु कै सेवा ॥
verses.tr:
madhukar khag mṛg tanu dhari devā
karahiṃ siddh muni prabhu kai sevā

verses.sa:
मंगलरुप भयउ बन तब ते ।
कीन्ह निवास रमापति जब ते ॥
verses.tr:
maṃgalarup bhayau ban tab te
kīnh nivās ramāpati jab te

verses.sa:
फटिक सिला अति सुभ्र सुहाई ।
सुख आसीन तहाँ द्वौ भाई ॥
verses.tr:
phaṭik silā ati subhr suhāī
sukh āsīn tahām̐ dvau bhāī

verses.sa:
कहत अनुज सन कथा अनेका ।
भगति बिरति नृपनीति बिबेका ॥
verses.tr:
kahat anuj san kathā anekā
bhagati birati nṛpanīti bibekā

verses.sa:
बरषा काल मेघ नभ छाए ।
गरजत लागत परम सुहाए ॥
verses.tr:
baraṣā kāl megh nabh chāe
garajat lāgat param suhāe

verses.sa:
लछिमन देखु मोर गन नाचत बारिद पैखि ।
गृही बिरति रत हरष जस बिष्नु भगत कहुँ देखि ॥
verses.tr:
lachiman dekhu mor gan nācat bārid paikhi
gṛhī birati rat haraṣ jas biṣnu bhagat kahum̐ dekhi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The magnificent forest was a most charming sight, with

the trees all in flower and the swarms of buzzing bees gathering honey. From the time that the Lord came, every plant and fruit and every kind of agreeable foliage was forthcoming in profusion. Seeing the incomparable beauty of the hill, the Lord and his brother rested there. In the form of bees, birds and deer, the gods, saints and seers came and did service to their lord. From the time that Lakshmi’s spouse took up his abode in it, the forest became a picture of felicity. There the two brothers sat at ease on the bright and glistening crystal rock, and the younger was told many a tale inculoating faith, self-governance, statecraft and wisdom. What with clouds that ever cano-pied the heavens and the frequent thunder, the season of _ the rains seemed a most delightful time.
“See, Lakshman, how the peacocks dance at the sight of the clouds, like a householder, enamoured of asceticism, who rejoices when he finds a true believer in Vishnu.

sections.label: Doha 14
sections.name: हरित भूमि तृन संकुल समुझि परहिं नहिं पंथ

verses.sa:
घन घमंड नभ गरजत घोरा ।
प्रिया हीन डरपत मन मोरा ॥
verses.tr:
ghan ghamaṃḍ nabh garajat ghorā
priyā hīn ḍarapat man morā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
दामिनि दमक रह न घन माहीं ।
खल कै प्रीति जथा थिर नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
dāmini damak rah na ghan māhīṃ
khal kai prīti jathā thir nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
बरषहिं जलद भूमि निअराएँ ।
जथा नवहिं बुध बिद्या पाएँ ॥
verses.tr:
baraṣahiṃ jalad bhūmi niarāem̐
jathā navahiṃ budh bidyā pāem̐

verses.sa:
बूँद अघात सहहिं गिरि कैंसें ।
खल के बचन संत सह जैसें ॥
verses.tr:
būm̐d aghāt sahahiṃ giri kaiṃseṃ
khal ke bacan saṃt sah jaiseṃ

verses.sa:
छुद्र नदीं भरि चलीं तोराई ।
जस थोरेहुँ धन खल इतराई ॥
verses.tr:
chudr nadīṃ bhari calīṃ torāī
jas thorehum̐ dhan khal itarāī

verses.sa:
भूमि परत भा ढाबर पानी ।
जनु जीवहि माया लपटानी ॥
verses.tr:
bhūmi parat bhā ḍhābar pānī
janu jīvahi māyā lapaṭānī

verses.sa:
समिटि समिटि जल भरहिं तलावा ।
जिमि सदगुन सज्जन पहिं आवा ॥
verses.tr:
samiṭi samiṭi jal bharahiṃ talāvā
jimi sadagun sajjan pahiṃ āvā

verses.sa:
सरिता जल जलनिधि महुँ जाई ।
होई अचल जिमि जिव हरि पाई ॥
verses.tr:
saritā jal jalanidhi mahum̐ jāī
hoī acal jimi jiv hari pāī

verses.sa:
हरित भूमि तृन संकुल समुझि परहिं नहिं पंथ ।
जिमि पाखंड बाद तें गुप्त होहिं सदग्रंथ ॥
verses.tr:
harit bhūmi tṛn saṃkul samujhi parahiṃ nahiṃ paṃth
jimi pākhaṃḍ bād teṃ gupt hohiṃ sadagraṃth
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Clouds gather in the sky and thunders roar; but my darling is gone and my soul is in distress!. The lightning flashes fitfully amid the darkness, like the friendship of the vile which never lasts. The pouring clouds cleave close to the ground, as sages stoop beneath accumulated lore. The mountain endures the buffeting of the storm, as the virtuous bear the abuse’ of the wicked. The flooded stream-lets rush proudly along, like mean men puffed up with a little wealth. The water by its contact with the earth becomes as muddy as the soul when environed by delusion. The lakes swell gradually and imperceptibly, like as when the quality of goodness developes in a good man; and the rivers flow into the bosom of the ocean, like as the soul, that has found Hari, is at rest for ever.
The green earth is so choked with grass that the paths can no longer be distinguished, like holy books obscured by the wrangling of heretics.

sections.label: Doha 15
sections.name: कबहुँ प्रबल बह मारुत जहँ तहँ मेघ बिलाहिं

verses.sa:
दादुर धुनि चहु दिसा सुहाई ।
बेद पढ़हिं जनु बटु समुदाई ॥
verses.tr:
dādur dhuni cahu disā suhāī
bed par̤hahiṃ janu baṭu samudāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नव पल्लव भए बिटप अनेका ।
साधक मन जस मिलें बिबेका ॥
verses.tr:
nav pallav bhae biṭap anekā
sādhak man jas mileṃ bibekā

verses.sa:
अर्क जबास पात बिनु भयऊ ।
जस सुराज खल उद्यम गयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
ark jabās pāt binu bhayaū
jas surāj khal udyam gayaū

verses.sa:
खोजत कतहुँ मिलइ नहिं धूरी ।
करइ क्रोध जिमि धरमहि दूरी ॥
verses.tr:
khojat katahum̐ milai nahiṃ dhūrī
karai krodh jimi dharamahi dūrī

verses.sa:
ससि संपन्न सोह महि कैसी ।
उपकारी कै संपति जैसी ॥
verses.tr:
sasi saṃpann soh mahi kaisī
upakārī kai saṃpati jaisī

verses.sa:
निसि तम घन खद्योत बिराजा ।
जनु दंभिन्ह कर मिला समाजा ॥
verses.tr:
nisi tam ghan khadyot birājā
janu daṃbhinh kar milā samājā

verses.sa:
महाबृष्टि चलि फूटि किआरीं ।
जिमि सुतंत्र भएँ बिगरहिं नारीं ॥
verses.tr:
mahābṛṣṭi cali phūṭi kiārīṃ
jimi sutaṃtr bhaem̐ bigarahiṃ nārīṃ

verses.sa:
कृषी निरावहिं चतुर किसाना ।
जिमि बुध तजहिं मोह मद माना ॥
verses.tr:
kṛṣī nirāvahiṃ catur kisānā
jimi budh tajahiṃ moh mad mānā

verses.sa:
देखिअत चक्रबाक खग नाहीं ।
कलिहि पाइ जिमि धर्म पराहीं ॥
verses.tr:
dekhiat cakrabāk khag nāhīṃ
kalihi pāi jimi dharm parāhīṃ

verses.sa:
ऊषर बरषइ तृन नहिं जामा ।
जिमि हरिजन हियँ उपज न कामा ॥
verses.tr:
ūṣar baraṣai tṛn nahiṃ jāmā
jimi harijan hiyam̐ upaj na kāmā

verses.sa:
बिबिध जंतु संकुल महि भ्राजा ।
प्रजा बाढ़ जिमि पाइ सुराजा ॥
verses.tr:
bibidh jaṃtu saṃkul mahi bhrājā
prajā bār̤h jimi pāi surājā

verses.sa:
जहँ तहँ रहे पथिक थकि नाना ।
जिमि इंद्रिय गन उपजें ग्याना ॥
verses.tr:
jaham̐ taham̐ rahe pathik thaki nānā
jimi iṃdriya gan upajeṃ gyānā

verses.sa:
कबहुँ प्रबल बह मारुत जहँ तहँ मेघ बिलाहिं ।
जिमि कपूत के उपजें कुल सद्धर्म नसाहिं ॥
verses.tr:
kabahum̐ prabal bah mārut jaham̐ taham̐ megh bilāhiṃ
jimi kapūt ke upajeṃ kul saddharm nasāhiṃ
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
कबहुँ दिवस महँ निबिड़ तम कबहुँक प्रगट पतंग ।
बिनसइ उपजइ ग्यान जिमि पाइ कुसंग सुसंग ॥
verses.tr:
kabahum̐ divas maham̐ nibir̤ tam kabahum̐k pragaṭ pataṃg
binasai upajai gyān jimi pāi kusaṃg susaṃg

trans: On all sides there is a lively croaking of frogs, like:

party of Brahman students repeating the Vedas. All the trees put forth their new leaves, like pious souls that have come to matured wisdom, The 4k and jawdsa plants lose their leaves: as ina well-governed realm the schemes of the wicked come to nought. Search as you like, the dusty footpath is no longer to be traced; like as when religion is put out of sight by passion. The earth rich with crops makes as goodly a show as the prosperity of benevolent. The fire flies glitter in the darkness of the cloudy night, like a mustered band of hypocritical pretenders. The ridges of the fields are broken down by the heavy rains, like women ruined by too much license. The diligent cultivators weed their lands, like philosophers who root up ignorance, vanity and pride. The chakwa and other birds are nowhere to be seen, like virtue that fled at the coming of the iron age. However much it may rain, no grass springs upon barren ground; so lust takes no root in the heart of Hari’s worshippers. The earth gleams with swarms of living creatures of every kind; so the people multiply under good government. Here and there weary wayfarers stay and rest, like a man’s bodily senses after the attainment of wisdom. Dohe 15.
At times a strong wind disperses the clouds in all directions, like the birth of a bad son, who destroys all the pious practices of his family.

sections.label: Doha 16
sections.name: चले हरषि तजि नगर नृप तापस बनिक भिखारि

verses.sa:
बरषा बिगत सरद रितु आई ।
लछिमन देखहु परम सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
baraṣā bigat sarad ritu āī
lachiman dekhahu param suhāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
फूलें कास सकल महि छाई ।
जनु बरषाँ कृत प्रगट बुढ़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
phūleṃ kās sakal mahi chāī
janu baraṣām̐ kṛt pragaṭ bur̤hāī

verses.sa:
उदित अगस्ति पंथ जल सोषा ।
जिमि लोभहि सोषइ संतोषा ॥
verses.tr:
udit agasti paṃth jal soṣā
jimi lobhahi soṣai saṃtoṣā

verses.sa:
सरिता सर निर्मल जल सोहा ।
संत हृदय जस गत मद मोहा ॥
verses.tr:
saritā sar nirmal jal sohā
saṃt hṛdaya jas gat mad mohā

verses.sa:
रस रस सूख सरित सर पानी ।
ममता त्याग करहिं जिमि ग्यानी ॥
verses.tr:
ras ras sūkh sarit sar pānī
mamatā tyāg karahiṃ jimi gyānī

verses.sa:
जानि सरद रितु खंजन आए ।
पाइ समय जिमि सुकृत सुहाए ॥
verses.tr:
jāni sarad ritu khaṃjan āe
pāi samaya jimi sukṛt suhāe

verses.sa:
पंक न रेनु सोह असि धरनी ।
नीति निपुन नृप कै जसि करनी ॥
verses.tr:
paṃk na renu soh asi dharanī
nīti nipun nṛp kai jasi karanī

verses.sa:
जल संकोच बिकल भइँ मीना ।
अबुध कुटुंबी जिमि धनहीना ॥
verses.tr:
jal saṃkoc bikal bhaim̐ mīnā
abudh kuṭuṃbī jimi dhanahīnā

verses.sa:
बिनु धन निर्मल सोह अकासा ।
हरिजन इव परिहरि सब आसा ॥
verses.tr:
binu dhan nirmal soh akāsā
harijan iv parihari sab āsā

verses.sa:
कहुँ कहुँ बृष्टि सारदी थोरी ।
कोउ एक पाव भगति जिमि मोरी ॥
verses.tr:
kahum̐ kahum̐ bṛṣṭi sāradī thorī
kou ek pāv bhagati jimi morī

verses.sa:
चले हरषि तजि नगर नृप तापस बनिक भिखारि ।
जिमि हरिभगत पाइ श्रम तजहि आश्रमी चारि ॥
verses.tr:
cale haraṣi taji nagar nṛp tāpas banik bhikhāri
jimi haribhagat pāi śram tajahi āśramī cāri
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Now the rains are over and the season of autumn has returned; see Lakshman, how exquisitely beautiful everything is. The whole earth is covered with the flowering kdns grass, as though the rains had exposed its old age. The rising of Canopus has dried up the water on the roads, like as greed is dried up by contentment. The surface of every river and lake is as pure and bright as is the soul of the saints devoid of all vanity and delusion; drop by drop their depths are diminished, like as the enlightened gradually lose all notions of self. The wagtails know the autumn season and come out once more, like virtuous deeds in an auspicious time. There is neither mud nor dust; the earth is as brilliant as the administration of a king who is well versed in state policy. The fish are distressed by the shrinking of the water. like improvident men of family by the loss of money. The unclouded sky shines as bright asa worshipper of Hari, who has discarded every other patron. Here and there is a slight autumn shower, like the faith of one who is not yet fully persuaded.
King and ascetics, merchants and mendicants, leave the city and go their way with joy, like men in any of the foar-stages of life!, who cease to labour when they have once attained to faith in Hari.

sections.label: Doha 17
sections.name: भूमि जीव संकुल रहे गए सरद रितु पाइ

verses.sa:
सुखी मीन जे नीर अगाधा ।
जिमि हरि सरन न एकउ बाधा ॥
verses.tr:
sukhī mīn je nīr agādhā
jimi hari saran na ekau bādhā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
फूलें कमल सोह सर कैसा ।
निर्गुन ब्रम्ह सगुन भएँ जैसा ॥
verses.tr:
phūleṃ kamal soh sar kaisā
nirgun bramh sagun bhaem̐ jaisā

verses.sa:
गुंजत मधुकर मुखर अनूपा ।
सुंदर खग रव नाना रूपा ॥
verses.tr:
guṃjat madhukar mukhar anūpā
suṃdar khag rav nānā rūpā

verses.sa:
चक्रबाक मन दुख निसि पैखी ।
जिमि दुर्जन पर संपति देखी ॥
verses.tr:
cakrabāk man dukh nisi paikhī
jimi durjan par saṃpati dekhī

verses.sa:
चातक रटत तृषा अति ओही ।
जिमि सुख लहइ न संकरद्रोही ॥
verses.tr:
cātak raṭat tṛṣā ati ohī
jimi sukh lahai na saṃkaradrohī

verses.sa:
सरदातप निसि ससि अपहरई ।
संत दरस जिमि पातक टरई ॥
verses.tr:
saradātap nisi sasi apaharaī
saṃt daras jimi pātak ṭaraī

verses.sa:
देखि इंदु चकोर समुदाई ।
चितवतहिं जिमि हरिजन हरि पाई ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi iṃdu cakor samudāī
citavatahiṃ jimi harijan hari pāī

verses.sa:
मसक दंस बीते हिम त्रासा ।
जिमि द्विज द्रोह किएँ कुल नासा ॥
verses.tr:
masak daṃs bīte him trāsā
jimi dvij droh kiem̐ kul nāsā

verses.sa:
भूमि जीव संकुल रहे गए सरद रितु पाइ ।
सदगुर मिले जाहिं जिमि संसय भ्रम समुदाइ ॥
verses.tr:
bhūmi jīv saṃkul rahe gae sarad ritu pāi
sadagur mile jāhiṃ jimi saṃsaya bhram samudāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Where the water is deep, the fish are as glad as men who have taken refuge with Hari and have nota single trouble. The lakes, with their flowering lotuses, are as beautiful as the immaterial Supreme Spirit when clothed with a material form. The garrulous bees make a wonderful buzzing, and the birds a charming concert of diverse sounds; but the chakwd is as sad of soul to see the night, asa bad manat the sight of another’s prosperity. The chatak cries out from excess of thirst, like a rebel against Mahadeva, who knows no rest. The moon by night subdues the autumnal heat of the sun, like as the sight of a saint expels sin. Flocks of partridges fix their gaze upon the moon, as Hari’s worshippers look only to Hari. Mosquitoes and gadflies are driven away by the terrors of winter, like as a family is destroyed by the sin of persecuting Brahmans.
Under the influence of the autumn, earth is rid of its

sections.label: Doha 18
sections.name: तब अनुजहि समुझावा रघुपति करुना सींव

verses.sa:
बरषा गत निर्मल रितु आई ।
सुधि न तात सीता कै पाई ॥
verses.tr:
baraṣā gat nirmal ritu āī
sudhi na tāt sītā kai pāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
एक बार कैसेहुँ सुधि जानौं ।
कालहु जीत निमिष महुँ आनौं ॥
verses.tr:
ek bār kaisehum̐ sudhi jānauṃ
kālahu jīt nimiṣ mahum̐ ānauṃ

verses.sa:
कतहुँ रहउ जौं जीवति होई ।
तात जतन करि आनेउँ सोई ॥
verses.tr:
katahum̐ rahau jauṃ jīvati hoī
tāt jatan kari āneum̐ soī

verses.sa:
सुग्रीवहुँ सुधि मोरि बिसारी ।
पावा राज कोस पुर नारी ॥
verses.tr:
sugrīvahum̐ sudhi mori bisārī
pāvā rāj kos pur nārī

verses.sa:
जेहिं सायक मारा मैं बाली ।
तेहिं सर हतौं मूढ़ कहँ काली ॥
verses.tr:
jehiṃ sāyak mārā maiṃ bālī
tehiṃ sar hatauṃ mūr̤h kaham̐ kālī

verses.sa:
जासु कृपाँ छूटहीं मद मोहा ।
ता कहुँ उमा कि सपनेहुँ कोहा ॥
verses.tr:
jāsu kṛpām̐ chūṭahīṃ mad mohā
tā kahum̐ umā ki sapanehum̐ kohā

verses.sa:
जानहिं यह चरित्र मुनि ग्यानी ।
जिन्ह रघुबीर चरन रति मानी ॥
verses.tr:
jānahiṃ yah caritr muni gyānī
jinh raghubīr caran rati mānī

verses.sa:
लछिमन क्रोधवंत प्रभु जाना ।
धनुष चढ़ाइ गहे कर बाना ॥
verses.tr:
lachiman krodhavaṃt prabhu jānā
dhanuṣ car̤hāi gahe kar bānā

verses.sa: तब अनुजहि समुझावा रघुपति करुना सींव ॥
verses.tr: tab anujahi samujhāvā raghupati karunā sīṃv
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: भय देखाइ लै आवहु तात सखा सुग्रीव ॥
verses.tr: bhaya dekhāi lai āvahu tāt sakhā sugrīv

trans: insect swarms, asa man, who has found a good teacher, is relieved from all doubt and error.

The rains are over and the clear season has come, but I have had no news, brother, of Sita. If I could only once anyhow get tidings of her, I would in an instant recover her out of the hands of even Death himself. Wherever she may be, if only she still lives, brother, I would make an® effort to rescue her. Sugriva has forgotten all about me,
ari, or stud ‘: i or householder; 3rd, tabt of the Vein ead ee ih Ss Sages,

t ite: of the Rhikshu, or mendicant. Presi RAr ar COnenorte aad “pee eos now that he has got back his kingdom and treasure, his city and his queen. Fool that he is, I will to-morrow slay him with the selfsame arrow with which I slew Bali.” He, by whose favour, Uma, pride and delusion are dissipated, could never even dream of being angry. Only enlightened saints can understand these actions of his, who have a hearty devotion to the feet of Raghubir. Lakshman believed his lord was angry, and strung his bow and took his arrows in his hands. Dohe 18.

sections.label: Doha 19
sections.name: धनुष चढ़ाइ कहा तब जारि करउँ पुर छार

verses.sa:
इहाँ पवनसुत हृदयँ बिचारा ।
राम काजु सुग्रीवँ बिसारा ॥
verses.tr:
ihām̐ pavanasut hṛdayam̐ bicārā
rām kāju sugrīvam̐ bisārā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
निकट जाइ चरनन्हि सिरु नावा ।
चारिहु बिधि तेहि कहि समुझावा ॥
verses.tr:
nikaṭ jāi carananhi siru nāvā
cārihu bidhi tehi kahi samujhāvā

verses.sa:
सुनि सुग्रीवँ परम भय माना ।
बिषयँ मोर हरि लीन्हेउ ग्याना ॥
verses.tr:
suni sugrīvam̐ param bhaya mānā
biṣayam̐ mor hari līnheu gyānā

verses.sa:
अब मारुतसुत दूत समूहा ।
पठवहु जहँ तहँ बानर जूहा ॥
verses.tr:
ab mārutasut dūt samūhā
paṭhavahu jaham̐ taham̐ bānar jūhā

verses.sa:
कहहु पाख महुँ आव न जोई ।
मोरें कर ता कर बध होई ॥
verses.tr:
kahahu pākh mahum̐ āv na joī
moreṃ kar tā kar badh hoī

verses.sa:
तब हनुमंत बोलाए दूता ।
सब कर करि सनमान बहूता ॥
verses.tr:
tab hanumaṃt bolāe dūtā
sab kar kari sanamān bahūtā

verses.sa:
भय अरु प्रीति नीति देखाई ।
चले सकल चरनन्हि सिर नाई ॥
verses.tr:
bhaya aru prīti nīti dekhāī
cale sakal carananhi sir nāī

verses.sa:
एहि अवसर लछिमन पुर आए ।
क्रोध देखि जहँ तहँ कपि धाए ॥
verses.tr:
ehi avasar lachiman pur āe
krodh dekhi jaham̐ taham̐ kapi dhāe

verses.sa:
धनुष चढ़ाइ कहा तब जारि करउँ पुर छार ।
ब्याकुल नगर देखि तब आयउ बालिकुमार ॥
verses.tr:
dhanuṣ car̤hāi kahā tab jāri karaum̐ pur chār
byākul nagar dekhi tab āyau bālikumār
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Theu the all-merciful Raghupati instructed his brother, saying: “Frighten our friend Sugriva and bring him here.”
Now the Son of the Wind also had thought to himself,

'Sugriva has forgotten all about Rama.' So he went near and bowed his head at his feet and reminded him of the four modes of making war.^ As Sugriva listened, he became much alarmed: " Sensual pleasures have robbed me of all my understanding. Now, 0 Hanuman, despatch a multitude of spies, legions of monkeys, in every direction, and tell them that any one who is not back in a fortnight shall meet his death at my hands." lianum^n then summoned envoys, and showed them all special honour, making use of threats, blandishments and motives of policy. They all bowed their head at his feet and set forth. At that very time Lakshman entered the city. Seeing him to be angry, (he monkeys all ran away.

sections.label: Doha 20
sections.name: हरषि चले सुग्रीव तब अंगदादि कपि साथ

verses.sa:
चरन नाइ सिरु बिनती कीन्ही ।
लछिमन अभय बाँह तेहि दीन्ही ॥
verses.tr:
caran nāi siru binatī kīnhī
lachiman abhaya bām̐h tehi dīnhī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
क्रोधवंत लछिमन सुनि काना ।
कह कपीस अति भयँ अकुलाना ॥
verses.tr:
krodhavaṃt lachiman suni kānā
kah kapīs ati bhayam̐ akulānā

verses.sa:
सुनु हनुमंत संग लै तारा ।
करि बिनती समुझाउ कुमारा ॥
verses.tr:
sunu hanumaṃt saṃg lai tārā
kari binatī samujhāu kumārā

verses.sa:
तारा सहित जाइ हनुमाना ।
चरन बंदि प्रभु सुजस बखाना ॥
verses.tr:
tārā sahit jāi hanumānā
caran baṃdi prabhu sujas bakhānā

verses.sa:
करि बिनती मंदिर लै आए ।
चरन पखारि पलँग बैठाए ॥
verses.tr:
kari binatī maṃdir lai āe
caran pakhāri palam̐g baiṭhāe

verses.sa:
तब कपीस चरनन्हि सिरु नावा ।
गहि भुज लछिमन कंठ लगावा ॥
verses.tr:
tab kapīs carananhi siru nāvā
gahi bhuj lachiman kaṃṭh lagāvā

verses.sa:
नाथ बिषय सम मद कछु नाहीं ।
मुनि मन मोह करइ छन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
nāth biṣaya sam mad kachu nāhīṃ
muni man moh karai chan māhīṃ

verses.sa:
सुनत बिनीत बचन सुख पावा ।
लछिमन तेहि बहु बिधि समुझावा ॥
verses.tr:
sunat binīt bacan sukh pāvā
lachiman tehi bahu bidhi samujhāvā

verses.sa:
पवन तनय सब कथा सुनाई ।
जेहि बिधि गए दूत समुदाई ॥
verses.tr:
pavan tanaya sab kathā sunāī
jehi bidhi gae dūt samudāī

verses.sa:
हरषि चले सुग्रीव तब अंगदादि कपि साथ ।
रामानुज आगें करि आए जहँ रघुनाथ ॥
verses.tr:
haraṣi cale sugrīv tab aṃgadādi kapi sāth
rāmānuj āgeṃ kari āe jaham̐ raghunāth
verses.head: दोहा

trans: He twanged his bow and cried ‘I will burn the city to ashes.’ Then came Bali’s son, seeing the distress of the people.

And bowed his head at his feet and made humble petition, till Lakshman assured him he had nought to fear. When the monkey king heard tell of Lakshman’s wrath, he was erribly alarmed: ‘“‘ Hearken, Hanuman; take Tara with you and with suppliant prayers appease the prince.’ Hanuman; went with Tera and fell at his feet, and after hymning his lord’s praises, respectfully conducted him to the palace and bathed his feet and seated him on a couch. The monkey king also bowed his head at his feet, but Lakshman took him by the hand and embraced him. “‘ There is nothing, my lord, so intoxicating as pleasure; ina single moment it infatuates even the soul of a saint.” On hearing this humble speech, Lakshman was glad and said everything to reassure him, while Hanuman told him all that had been done and how a multitude of spies had already started. 2
Then Sugriva with Angad and the other monkeys went forth with joy, preceded by Lakshman, and arrived in RAma's presence.

sections.label: Doha 21
sections.name: एहि बिधि होत बतकही आए बानर जूथ

verses.sa:
नाइ चरन सिरु कह कर जोरी ।
नाथ मोहि कछु नाहिन खोरी ॥
verses.tr:
nāi caran siru kah kar jorī
nāth mohi kachu nāhin khorī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
अतिसय प्रबल देव तब माया ।
छूटइ राम करहु जौं दाया ॥
verses.tr:
atisaya prabal dev tab māyā
chūṭai rām karahu jauṃ dāyā

verses.sa:
बिषय बस्य सुर नर मुनि स्वामी ।
मैं पावँर पसु कपि अति कामी ॥
verses.tr:
biṣaya basya sur nar muni svāmī
maiṃ pāvam̐r pasu kapi ati kāmī

verses.sa:
नारि नयन सर जाहि न लागा ।
घोर क्रोध तम निसि जो जागा ॥
verses.tr:
nāri nayan sar jāhi na lāgā
ghor krodh tam nisi jo jāgā

verses.sa:
लोभ पाँस जेहिं गर न बँधाया ।
सो नर तुम्ह समान रघुराया ॥
verses.tr:
lobh pām̐s jehiṃ gar na bam̐dhāyā
so nar tumh samān raghurāyā

verses.sa:
यह गुन साधन तें नहिं होई ।
तुम्हरी कृपाँ पाव कोइ कोई ॥
verses.tr:
yah gun sādhan teṃ nahiṃ hoī
tumharī kṛpām̐ pāv koi koī

verses.sa:
तब रघुपति बोले मुसकाई ।
तुम्ह प्रिय मोहि भरत जिमि भाई ॥
verses.tr:
tab raghupati bole musakāī
tumh priya mohi bharat jimi bhāī

verses.sa:
अब सोइ जतनु करहु मन लाई ।
जेहि बिधि सीता कै सुधि पाई ॥
verses.tr:
ab soi jatanu karahu man lāī
jehi bidhi sītā kai sudhi pāī

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि होत बतकही आए बानर जूथ ।
नाना बरन सकल दिसि देखिअ कीस बरुथ ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi hot batakahī āe bānar jūth
nānā baran sakal disi dekhia kīs baruth
verses.head: दोहा

trans: With folded hands he bowed his head at his feet and cried: ‘My lord, it has been no fault of mine. Your delusive power, sire, is so strong that only Rama’s favour can disperse it. Gods and men, saints and kings are mastered by their senses; and I am but a poor brute beast, a monkey, one of the most libidinous of animals. A man who is invulnerable by the arrow of a -woman's eye, who remains wakeful through the dark night of angry passion, and whose neck has never been bound by the halter of covetousness, is your equal, O Raghurdi. It is a virtue not attainable by any religious observance; it is only by your grace that one here and one there can accomplish it.” Then Raghupati smiled and said: ‘You are as dear to me as my own brother Bharat. Now take thought and make an effort to get tidings of Sita.”
While they were yet thus speaking, the troops of monkeys arrived of all coloursand from all parts of the world, a monkey host marvellous to behold.

sections.label: Doha 22
sections.name: बचन सुनत सब बानर जहँ तहँ चले तुरंत

verses.sa:
बानर कटक उमा में देखा ।
सो मूरुख जो करन चह लेखा ॥
verses.tr:
bānar kaṭak umā meṃ dekhā
so mūrukh jo karan cah lekhā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
आइ राम पद नावहिं माथा ।
निरखि बदनु सब होहिं सनाथा ॥
verses.tr:
āi rām pad nāvahiṃ māthā
nirakhi badanu sab hohiṃ sanāthā

verses.sa:
अस कपि एक न सेना माहीं ।
राम कुसल जेहि पूछी नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
as kapi ek na senā māhīṃ
rām kusal jehi pūchī nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
यह कछु नहिं प्रभु कइ अधिकाई ।
बिस्वरूप ब्यापक रघुराई ॥
verses.tr:
yah kachu nahiṃ prabhu kai adhikāī
bisvarūp byāpak raghurāī

verses.sa:
ठाढ़े जहँ तहँ आयसु पाई ।
कह सुग्रीव सबहि समुझाई ॥
verses.tr:
ṭhār̤he jaham̐ taham̐ āyasu pāī
kah sugrīv sabahi samujhāī

verses.sa:
राम काजु अरु मोर निहोरा ।
बानर जूथ जाहु चहुँ ओरा ॥
verses.tr:
rām kāju aru mor nihorā
bānar jūth jāhu cahum̐ orā

verses.sa:
जनकसुता कहुँ खोजहु जाई ।
मास दिवस महँ आएहु भाई ॥
verses.tr:
janakasutā kahum̐ khojahu jāī
mās divas maham̐ āehu bhāī

verses.sa:
अवधि मेटि जो बिनु सुधि पाएँ ।
आवइ बनिहि सो मोहि मराएँ ॥
verses.tr:
avadhi meṭi jo binu sudhi pāem̐
āvai banihi so mohi marāem̐

verses.sa:
बचन सुनत सब बानर जहँ तहँ चले तुरंत ।
तब सुग्रीवँ बोलाए अंगद नल हनुमंत ॥
verses.tr:
bacan sunat sab bānar jaham̐ taham̐ cale turaṃt
tab sugrīvam̐ bolāe aṃgad nal hanumaṃt
verses.head: दोहा

trans: I, Uma, saw this army of monkeys; only a fool would try to count them. ‘They came and bowed the head at RAma's feet and gazing upon his face found in him their true lord. In the whole host there was not a single monkey towhom Rama did not give separate greeting. This is no great miracle for the lord Raghurdi, who is omnipresent and all pervading. They all stood as they were told, rank after rank, while Sugriva thus spoke and instructed them: “Ta Rama’s behoof andat my request, go forth ye monkey host in every direction. Make search for Janak’s daughter, my brethren, and return within a month. Whoever comes back at the end of the time without any news shall die at my hands.”
No sooner had they heard this speech than all the monkeys started at once in every direction. Sugriva then called Angad, Nila and Hanuman:

sections.label: Doha 23
sections.name: चले सकल बन खोजत सरिता सर गिरि खोह

verses.sa:
सुनहु नील अंगद हनुमाना ।
जामवंत मतिधीर सुजाना ॥
verses.tr:
sunahu nīl aṃgad hanumānā
jāmavaṃt matidhīr sujānā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सकल सुभट मिलि दच्छिन जाहू ।
सीता सुधि पूँछेउ सब काहू ॥
verses.tr:
sakal subhaṭ mili dacchin jāhū
sītā sudhi pūm̐cheu sab kāhū

verses.sa:
मन क्रम बचन सो जतन बिचारेहु ।
रामचंद्र कर काजु सँवारेहु ॥
verses.tr:
man kram bacan so jatan bicārehu
rāmacaṃdr kar kāju sam̐vārehu

verses.sa:
भानु पीठि सेइअ उर आगी ।
स्वामिहि सर्ब भाव छल त्यागी ॥
verses.tr:
bhānu pīṭhi seia ur āgī
svāmihi sarb bhāv chal tyāgī

verses.sa:
तजि माया सेइअ परलोका ।
मिटहिं सकल भव संभव सोका ॥
verses.tr:
taji māyā seia paralokā
miṭahiṃ sakal bhav saṃbhav sokā

verses.sa:
देह धरे कर यह फलु भाई ।
भजिअ राम सब काम बिहाई ॥
verses.tr:
deh dhare kar yah phalu bhāī
bhajia rām sab kām bihāī

verses.sa:
सोइ गुनग्य सोई बड़भागी ।
जो रघुबीर चरन अनुरागी ॥
verses.tr:
soi gunagya soī bar̤abhāgī
jo raghubīr caran anurāgī

verses.sa:
आयसु मागि चरन सिरु नाई ।
चले हरषि सुमिरत रघुराई ॥
verses.tr:
āyasu māgi caran siru nāī
cale haraṣi sumirat raghurāī

verses.sa:
पाछें पवन तनय सिरु नावा ।
जानि काज प्रभु निकट बोलावा ॥
verses.tr:
pācheṃ pavan tanaya siru nāvā
jāni kāj prabhu nikaṭ bolāvā

verses.sa:
परसा सीस सरोरुह पानी ।
करमुद्रिका दीन्हि जन जानी ॥
verses.tr:
parasā sīs saroruh pānī
karamudrikā dīnhi jan jānī

verses.sa:
बहु प्रकार सीतहि समुझाएहु ।
कहि बल बिरह बेगि तुम्ह आएहु ॥
verses.tr:
bahu prakār sītahi samujhāehu
kahi bal birah begi tumh āehu

verses.sa:
हनुमत जन्म सुफल करि माना ।
चलेउ हृदयँ धरि कृपानिधाना ॥
verses.tr:
hanumat janm suphal kari mānā
caleu hṛdayam̐ dhari kṛpānidhānā

verses.sa:
जद्यपि प्रभु जानत सब बाता ।
राजनीति राखत सुरत्राता ॥
verses.tr:
jadyapi prabhu jānat sab bātā
rājanīti rākhat suratrātā

verses.sa:
चले सकल बन खोजत सरिता सर गिरि खोह ।
राम काज लयलीन मन बिसरा तन कर छोह ॥
verses.tr:
cale sakal ban khojat saritā sar giri khoh
rām kāj layalīn man bisarā tan kar choh
verses.head: दोहा

trans: ‘“ Hearken, Nila, Angad and Hanuman, and you, O staunch and sagacious Jambavan; go ye together, all ye gallant warriors, to the south, and ask every one for news of Sita. Strain every faculty to devise some way of accomplishing Rama’s object. The sun is content with back service and the fire with front, but a master must be served back and front alike, without any subterfuges. Disoard the unreali-ties of the world and consider the future; so shall all the troubles connected with existence be destroyed. This is the end, brother, for which we were born, to worship Rama without any desire for self. He only is truly discrimi-native, he only is greatly blessed, who is enamoured of the feet of Raghubir.” After begging permission to depart and bowing the head at his feet they set out with joy, invoking Raghu di. The last to make obeisance was Hanuman. The lord, knowing that would happen, called him near and with his lotus hands touched his head and gave him his ring off his finger for he knew his devotion: “Say everything to comfort Sita, telling her of my might and my constancy, and come quickly.” Haoumaeo thought himself happy to have been born and set forth, with the image of the all-mercifal impressed upon his heart. Although the Lord knows everything, he observes the rules of statecraft in his character as the champion of the gods.
They went forth searching every wood, river, lake, and mountain cave, with their soul so absorbed in Rama's concerns that they forgot all about their own bodily wants.

sections.label: Doha 24
sections.name: दीख जाइ उपवन बर सर बिगसित बहु कंज

verses.sa:
कतहुँ होइ निसिचर सैं भेटा ।
प्रान लेहिं एक एक चपेटा ॥
verses.tr:
katahum̐ hoi nisicar saiṃ bheṭā
prān lehiṃ ek ek capeṭā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बहु प्रकार गिरि कानन हेरहिं ।
कोउ मुनि मिलत ताहि सब घेरहिं ॥
verses.tr:
bahu prakār giri kānan herahiṃ
kou muni milat tāhi sab gherahiṃ

verses.sa:
लागि तृषा अतिसय अकुलाने ।
मिलइ न जल घन गहन भुलाने ॥
verses.tr:
lāgi tṛṣā atisaya akulāne
milai na jal ghan gahan bhulāne

verses.sa:
मन हनुमान कीन्ह अनुमाना ।
मरन चहत सब बिनु जल पाना ॥
verses.tr:
man hanumān kīnh anumānā
maran cahat sab binu jal pānā

verses.sa:
चढ़ि गिरि सिखर चहूँ दिसि देखा ।
भूमि बिबिर एक कौतुक पेखा ॥
verses.tr:
car̤hi giri sikhar cahūm̐ disi dekhā
bhūmi bibir ek kautuk pekhā

verses.sa:
चक्रबाक बक हंस उड़ाहीं ।
बहुतक खग प्रबिसहिं तेहि माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
cakrabāk bak haṃs ur̤āhīṃ
bahutak khag prabisahiṃ tehi māhīṃ

verses.sa:
गिरि ते उतरि पवनसुत आवा ।
सब कहुँ लै सोइ बिबर देखावा ॥
verses.tr:
giri te utari pavanasut āvā
sab kahum̐ lai soi bibar dekhāvā

verses.sa:
आगें कै हनुमंतहि लीन्हा ।
पैठे बिबर बिलंबु न कीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
āgeṃ kai hanumaṃtahi līnhā
paiṭhe bibar bilaṃbu na kīnhā

verses.sa:
दीख जाइ उपवन बर सर बिगसित बहु कंज ।
मंदिर एक रुचिर तहँ बैठि नारि तप पुंज ॥
verses.tr:
dīkh jāi upavan bar sar bigasit bahu kaṃj
maṃdir ek rucir taham̐ baiṭhi nāri tap puṃj
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Wherever it might be that they came across a demon, they took his life with a single blow. They looked into every recess of forest and hill, and if they met any hermit they all surrounded him. Overcome by thirst they were dreadfully distrest, and losing their way in the dense jangle, could find no water. Hanameo thought to himself “without water to drink we shall all die. He climbed a mountain peak and looking all] round about, spied a strange openiny in the ground; with geese, herons and swans on the wing and all kinds of birds making their way into it. Then Hanuman came down from the mountain and took them all and showed them this cavern, and with him to lead the way they Lost no time, but entered the chasm.
A grove and beautiful lake came in sight, with many flowering lotuses and a magnificent temple, where 2 holy woman was sitting.

sections.label: Doha 25
sections.name: बदरीबन कहुँ सो गई प्रभु अग्या धरि सीस

verses.sa:
दूरि ते ताहि सबन्हि सिर नावा ।
पूछें निज बृत्तांत सुनावा ॥
verses.tr:
dūri te tāhi sabanhi sir nāvā
pūcheṃ nij bṛttāṃt sunāvā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तेहिं तब कहा करहु जल पाना ।
खाहु सुरस सुंदर फल नाना ॥
verses.tr:
tehiṃ tab kahā karahu jal pānā
khāhu suras suṃdar phal nānā

verses.sa:
मज्जनु कीन्ह मधुर फल खाए ।
तासु निकट पुनि सब चलि आए ॥
verses.tr:
majjanu kīnh madhur phal khāe
tāsu nikaṭ puni sab cali āe

verses.sa:
तेहिं सब आपनि कथा सुनाई ।
मैं अब जाब जहाँ रघुराई ॥
verses.tr:
tehiṃ sab āpani kathā sunāī
maiṃ ab jāb jahām̐ raghurāī

verses.sa:
मूदहु नयन बिबर तजि जाहू ।
पैहहु सीतहि जनि पछिताहू ॥
verses.tr:
mūdahu nayan bibar taji jāhū
paihahu sītahi jani pachitāhū

verses.sa:
नयन मूदि पुनि देखहिं बीरा ।
ठाढ़े सकल सिंधु कें तीरा ॥
verses.tr:
nayan mūdi puni dekhahiṃ bīrā
ṭhār̤he sakal siṃdhu keṃ tīrā

verses.sa:
सो पुनि गई जहाँ रघुनाथा ।
जाइ कमल पद नाएसि माथा ॥
verses.tr:
so puni gaī jahām̐ raghunāthā
jāi kamal pad nāesi māthā

verses.sa:
नाना भाँति बिनय तेहिं कीन्ही ।
अनपायनी भगति प्रभु दीन्ही ॥
verses.tr:
nānā bhām̐ti binaya tehiṃ kīnhī
anapāyanī bhagati prabhu dīnhī

verses.sa:
बदरीबन कहुँ सो गई प्रभु अग्या धरि सीस ।
उर धरि राम चरन जुग जे बंदत अज ईस ॥
verses.tr:
badarīban kahum̐ so gaī prabhu agyā dhari sīs
ur dhari rām caran jug je baṃdat aj īs
verses.head: दोहा

sections.label: Doha 26
sections.name: निज इच्छा प्रभु अवतरइ सुर महि गो द्विज लागि

verses.sa:
इहाँ बिचारहिं कपि मन माहीं ।
बीती अवधि काज कछु नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
ihām̐ bicārahiṃ kapi man māhīṃ
bītī avadhi kāj kachu nāhīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सब मिलि कहहिं परस्पर बाता ।
बिनु सुधि लएँ करब का भ्राता ॥
verses.tr:
sab mili kahahiṃ paraspar bātā
binu sudhi laem̐ karab kā bhrātā

verses.sa:
कह अंगद लोचन भरि बारी ।
दुहुँ प्रकार भइ मृत्यु हमारी ॥
verses.tr:
kah aṃgad locan bhari bārī
duhum̐ prakār bhai mṛtyu hamārī

verses.sa:
इहाँ न सुधि सीता कै पाई ।
उहाँ गएँ मारिहि कपिराई ॥
verses.tr:
ihām̐ na sudhi sītā kai pāī
uhām̐ gaem̐ mārihi kapirāī

verses.sa:
पिता बधे पर मारत मोही ।
राखा राम निहोर न ओही ॥
verses.tr:
pitā badhe par mārat mohī
rākhā rām nihor na ohī

verses.sa:
पुनि पुनि अंगद कह सब पाहीं ।
मरन भयउ कछु संसय नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
puni puni aṃgad kah sab pāhīṃ
maran bhayau kachu saṃsaya nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
अंगद बचन सुनत कपि बीरा ।
बोलि न सकहिं नयन बह नीरा ॥
verses.tr:
aṃgad bacan sunat kapi bīrā
boli na sakahiṃ nayan bah nīrā

verses.sa:
छन एक सोच मगन होइ रहे ।
पुनि अस वचन कहत सब भए ॥
verses.tr:
chan ek soc magan hoi rahe
puni as vacan kahat sab bhae

verses.sa:
हम सीता कै सुधि लिन्हें बिना ।
नहिं जैंहैं जुबराज प्रबीना ॥
verses.tr:
ham sītā kai sudhi linheṃ binā
nahiṃ jaiṃhaiṃ jubarāj prabīnā

verses.sa:
अस कहि लवन सिंधु तट जाई ।
बैठे कपि सब दर्भ डसाई ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi lavan siṃdhu taṭ jāī
baiṭhe kapi sab darbh ḍasāī

verses.sa:
जामवंत अंगद दुख देखी ।
कहिं कथा उपदेस बिसेषी ॥
verses.tr:
jāmavaṃt aṃgad dukh dekhī
kahiṃ kathā upades biseṣī

verses.sa:
तात राम कहुँ नर जनि मानहु ।
निर्गुन ब्रम्ह अजित अज जानहु ॥
verses.tr:
tāt rām kahum̐ nar jani mānahu
nirgun bramh ajit aj jānahu

verses.sa:
हम सब सेवक अति बड़भागी ।
संतत सगुन ब्रह्म अनुरागी ॥
verses.tr:
ham sab sevak ati bar̤abhāgī
saṃtat sagun brahm anurāgī

verses.sa:
निज इच्छा प्रभु अवतरइ सुर महि गो द्विज लागि ।
सगुन उपासक संग तहँ रहहिं मोच्छ सब त्यागि ॥
verses.tr:
nij icchā prabhu avatarai sur mahi go dvij lāgi
sagun upāsak saṃg taham̐ rahahiṃ mocch sab tyāgi
verses.head: दोहा
