Now the monkeys were thinking to themselves: “The appointed time has passed and nothing has been done.” So they all came together and asked one another, “there is no news, brother; what are we to do?” Angad’s eyes were full of tearsas he replied: “It is death for us either way. Here we have failed to get tidings of Sita, and if we go home our king will slay us, After my father’s death he would have killed me, had not Rama protected me, no thinks to him.” Again and again Angad told them all: “It is a cause of death without a doubt.” When the monkey chiefs heard Angad’s words, they could make no answer, tears streamed from theireyes. For s moment they were overwhelmed with despair, but at last they all] spoke and said “unless we get news of Sita we will not return, O sagacious prince.” So saying the monkeys all went to the seashore, where they spread beds vf kusa grass and sat down. But Jambavan, seeing Angad’s distress, addressed him with a discourse of appropriate admonition: “My son, do not imagine Rama to be a man; know that he is the invisible god, unconquerable and from everlasting. All we who are his servants are most highly blessed in our love for the eternal God thus made incarnate.
Of his own free will the Lord has manifested himself on behalf of gods, Brahmans, cows and Earth, and remains in bodily form among his worshippers, having abandoned all the joysof heaven.”

sections.label: Doha 27
sections.name: मोहि लै जाहु सिंधुतट देउँ तिलांजलि ताहि

verses.sa: एहि बिधि कथा कहहि बहु भाँती गिरि कंदराँ सुनी संपाती ॥
verses.tr: ehi bidhi kathā kahahi bahu bhām̐tī giri kaṃdarām̐ sunī saṃpātī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बाहेर होइ देखि बहु कीसा ।
मोहि अहार दीन्ह जगदीसा ॥
verses.tr:
bāher hoi dekhi bahu kīsā
mohi ahār dīnh jagadīsā

verses.sa:
आजु सबहि कहँ भच्छन करऊँ ।
दिन बहु चले अहार बिनु मरऊँ ॥
verses.tr:
āju sabahi kaham̐ bhacchan karaūm̐
din bahu cale ahār binu maraūm̐

verses.sa:
कबहुँ न मिल भरि उदर अहारा ।
आजु दीन्ह बिधि एकहिं बारा ॥
verses.tr:
kabahum̐ na mil bhari udar ahārā
āju dīnh bidhi ekahiṃ bārā

verses.sa:
डरपे गीध बचन सुनि काना ।
अब भा मरन सत्य हम जाना ॥
verses.tr:
ḍarape gīdh bacan suni kānā
ab bhā maran satya ham jānā

verses.sa:
कपि सब उठे गीध कहँ देखी ।
जामवंत मन सोच बिसेषी ॥
verses.tr:
kapi sab uṭhe gīdh kaham̐ dekhī
jāmavaṃt man soc biseṣī

verses.sa:
कह अंगद बिचारि मन माहीं ।
धन्य जटायू सम कोउ नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
kah aṃgad bicāri man māhīṃ
dhanya jaṭāyū sam kou nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
राम काज कारन तनु त्यागी ।
हरि पुर गयउ परम बड़ भागी ॥
verses.tr:
rām kāj kāran tanu tyāgī
hari pur gayau param bar̤ bhāgī

verses.sa:
सुनि खग हरष सोक जुत बानी ।
आवा निकट कपिन्ह भय मानी ॥
verses.tr:
suni khag haraṣ sok jut bānī
āvā nikaṭ kapinh bhaya mānī

verses.sa:
तिन्हहि अभय करि पूछेसि जाई ।
कथा सकल तिन्ह ताहि सुनाई ॥
verses.tr:
tinhahi abhaya kari pūchesi jāī
kathā sakal tinh tāhi sunāī

verses.sa:
सुनि संपाति बंधु कै करनी ।
रघुपति महिमा बधुबिधि बरनी ॥
verses.tr:
suni saṃpāti baṃdhu kai karanī
raghupati mahimā badhubidhi baranī

verses.sa:
मोहि लै जाहु सिंधुतट देउँ तिलांजलि ताहि ।
बचन सहाइ करवि मैं पैहहु खोजहु जाहि ॥
verses.tr:
mohi lai jāhu siṃdhutaṭ deum̐ tilāṃjali tāhi
bacan sahāi karavi maiṃ paihahu khojahu jāhi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: He exhorted him in this wise at great length, and Sampati from his cave in the mountain heard him. When he came out and saw the multitude of monkeys, he cried: ‘God has provided me with a feast. I will eat them all up at once; I am dying for want of a meal these many days past. I have never yet had a good bellyful, but to-day God has supplied me for once and all.” The monkeys trembled to hear the vulture’s words, ‘we were right in saying to-day we must die.’ At the sight of him they all rose up, and Jambavan was mightily disturbed at heart; but Angad, after thinking to himself, exclaimed: Glory to Jateyu, there is none like him. who gave up his life in RAma's service and, blessed beyond measure, has been translated to Hari’s sphere in heaven.” When the bird heard these words of mingled joy and sadness, he drew near to the monkeys in alarm and after assuring them of safety began to question them. They told him the whole history. When Sampati heard of his brother’s doings, he gave great glory to Ragbupati.
‘Take me to the sea-shore and make him an offering of sesamum seeds; with the help of my instructions you shall recover her whom you seek.”

sections.label: Doha 28
sections.name: मैं देखउँ तुम्ह नाहि गीघहि दष्टि अपार

verses.sa:
अनुज क्रिया करि सागर तीरा ।
कहि निज कथा सुनहु कपि बीरा ॥
verses.tr:
anuj kriyā kari sāgar tīrā
kahi nij kathā sunahu kapi bīrā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
हम द्वौ बंधु प्रथम तरुनाई ।
गगन गए रबि निकट उडाई ॥
verses.tr:
ham dvau baṃdhu pratham tarunāī
gagan gae rabi nikaṭ uḍāī

verses.sa:
तेज न सहि सक सो फिरि आवा ।
मै अभिमानी रबि निअरावा ॥
verses.tr:
tej na sahi sak so phiri āvā
mai abhimānī rabi niarāvā

verses.sa:
जरे पंख अति तेज अपारा ।
परेउँ भूमि करि घोर चिकारा ॥
verses.tr:
jare paṃkh ati tej apārā
pareum̐ bhūmi kari ghor cikārā

verses.sa:
मुनि एक नाम चंद्रमा ओही ।
लागी दया देखी करि मोही ॥
verses.tr:
muni ek nām caṃdramā ohī
lāgī dayā dekhī kari mohī

verses.sa:
बहु प्रकार तेंहि ग्यान सुनावा ।
देहि जनित अभिमानी छड़ावा ॥
verses.tr:
bahu prakār teṃhi gyān sunāvā
dehi janit abhimānī char̤āvā

verses.sa:
त्रेताँ ब्रह्म मनुज तनु धरिही ।
तासु नारि निसिचर पति हरिही ॥
verses.tr:
tretām̐ brahm manuj tanu dharihī
tāsu nāri nisicar pati harihī

verses.sa:
तासु खोज पठइहि प्रभू दूता ।
तिन्हहि मिलें तैं होब पुनीता ॥
verses.tr:
tāsu khoj paṭhaihi prabhū dūtā
tinhahi mileṃ taiṃ hob punītā

verses.sa:
जमिहहिं पंख करसि जनि चिंता ।
तिन्हहि देखाइ देहेसु तैं सीता ॥
verses.tr:
jamihahiṃ paṃkh karasi jani ciṃtā
tinhahi dekhāi dehesu taiṃ sītā

verses.sa:
मुनि कइ गिरा सत्य भइ आजू ।
सुनि मम बचन करहु प्रभु काजू ॥
verses.tr:
muni kai girā satya bhai ājū
suni mam bacan karahu prabhu kājū

verses.sa:
गिरि त्रिकूट ऊपर बस लंका ।
तहँ रह रावन सहज असंका ॥
verses.tr:
giri trikūṭ ūpar bas laṃkā
taham̐ rah rāvan sahaj asaṃkā

verses.sa:
तहँ असोक उपबन जहँ रहई ।
सीता बैठि सोच रत अहई ॥
verses.tr:
taham̐ asok upaban jaham̐ rahaī
sītā baiṭhi soc rat ahaī

verses.sa: मैं देखउँ तुम्ह नाहि गीघहि दष्टि अपार ॥
verses.tr: maiṃ dekhaum̐ tumh nāhi gīghahi daṣṭi apār
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: बूढ भयउँ न त करतेउँ कछुक सहाय तुम्हार ॥
verses.tr: būḍh bhayaum̐ na ta karateum̐ kachuk sahāya tumhār

trans: When he had completed the funeral rites for his brother oo the seashore, he told them his own history. “Hearken, monkey chiefs. We two brothers in our first youth mounted into the heaven, winging our way towards the sun. He could not endure its splendour and turned back, but I in my pride went closer. My wings were scorched by the excessive heat, and I fell to the earth uttering fearful cries. A saint, by name Chandrama, was moved with compassion when he saw me, and instructed me in all kinds of knowledge and rid me of my inveterate pride. ‘In the Treta age God will take the form of a man, and his spouse will be carried off by the king of the demons. The Lord will send out spies to search for her, and if you join them you will be purified. Your wings will sprout again, fear not, when you have found them Sita.” The saint’s prophecy has come true to-day. Hearken to my words and set about your lord's business. On the top of mount Triktt is the city of Lanka; there lives Ravan in absolute security, and there, in a grove of Asoka trees, sits Sita, a prey to grief.
I see her, though you cannot; a vulture’s sight has no bounds. Iam nowold, or else I would have given you some assistance.

sections.label: Doha 29
sections.name: बलि बाँधत प्रभु बाढेउ सो तनु बरनि न जाई

verses.sa:
जो नाघइ सत जोजन सागर ।
करइ सो राम काज मति आगर ॥
verses.tr:
jo nāghai sat jojan sāgar
karai so rām kāj mati āgar
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मोहि बिलोकि धरहु मन धीरा ।
राम कृपाँ कस भयउ सरीरा ॥
verses.tr:
mohi biloki dharahu man dhīrā
rām kṛpām̐ kas bhayau sarīrā

verses.sa:
पापिउ जा कर नाम सुमिरहीं ।
अति अपार भवसागर तरहीं ॥
verses.tr:
pāpiu jā kar nām sumirahīṃ
ati apār bhavasāgar tarahīṃ

verses.sa:
तासु दूत तुम्ह तजि कदराई ।
राम हृदयँ धरि करहु उपाई ॥
verses.tr:
tāsu dūt tumh taji kadarāī
rām hṛdayam̐ dhari karahu upāī

verses.sa:
अस कहि गरुड़ गीध जब गयऊ ।
तिन्ह कें मन अति बिसमय भयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi garur̤ gīdh jab gayaū
tinh keṃ man ati bisamaya bhayaū

verses.sa:
निज निज बल सब काहूँ भाषा ।
पार जाइ कर संसय राखा ॥
verses.tr:
nij nij bal sab kāhūm̐ bhāṣā
pār jāi kar saṃsaya rākhā

verses.sa:
जरठ भयउँ अब कहइ रिछेसा ।
नहिं तन रहा प्रथम बल लेसा ॥
verses.tr:
jaraṭh bhayaum̐ ab kahai richesā
nahiṃ tan rahā pratham bal lesā

verses.sa:
जबहिं त्रिबिक्रम भए खरारी ।
तब मैं तरुन रहेउँ बल भारी ॥
verses.tr:
jabahiṃ tribikram bhae kharārī
tab maiṃ tarun raheum̐ bal bhārī

verses.sa:
बलि बाँधत प्रभु बाढेउ सो तनु बरनि न जाई ।
उभय धरी महँ दीन्ही सात प्रदच्छिन धाइ ॥
verses.tr:
bali bām̐dhat prabhu bāḍheu so tanu barani na jāī
ubhaya dharī maham̐ dīnhī sāt pradacchin dhāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: If any one of you can leap over a hundred leagues of sea, he will do Rama's business for him very cleverly. Look at

me reassure yourselves; see how my body has been restored by Rama's favour. Any wretch, who invokes his name, is able to cross the vast and boundless ocean of existence, and you are his messengers; have then no fear, but with Rama's image impressed upon your soul, concert your plans.” So saying, Garur, the vulture, left them, and their soul was in the greatest amazement. Each one vaunted his own strength, but doabted whether he could leap across, Said the king of the bears, *‘ [ am now too old and not a particle of my former strength is left in my body; when Khareri took his three strides then I was young and full of vigour,
As he fettered Bali, the lord increased in stature to an indescribable size, but in less than an hour I ran round him seven times.”

sections.label: Doha 30
sections.name: भव भेषज रघुनाथ जसु सुनहिं जे नर अरु नारि

verses.sa:
अंगद कहइ जाउँ मैं पारा ।
जियँ संसय कछु फिरती बारा ॥
verses.tr:
aṃgad kahai jāum̐ maiṃ pārā
jiyam̐ saṃsaya kachu phiratī bārā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जामवंत कह तुम्ह सब लायक ।
पठइअ किमि सबही कर नायक ॥
verses.tr:
jāmavaṃt kah tumh sab lāyak
paṭhaia kimi sabahī kar nāyak

verses.sa:
कहइ रीछपति सुनु हनुमाना ।
का चुप साधि रहेहु बलवाना ॥
verses.tr:
kahai rīchapati sunu hanumānā
kā cup sādhi rahehu balavānā

verses.sa:
पवन तनय बल पवन समाना ।
बुधि बिबेक बिग्यान निधाना ॥
verses.tr:
pavan tanaya bal pavan samānā
budhi bibek bigyān nidhānā

verses.sa:
कवन सो काज कठिन जग माहीं ।
जो नहिं होइ तात तुम्ह पाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
kavan so kāj kaṭhin jag māhīṃ
jo nahiṃ hoi tāt tumh pāhīṃ

verses.sa:
राम काज लगि तव अवतारा ।
सुनतहिं भयउ पर्बताकारा ॥
verses.tr:
rām kāj lagi tav avatārā
sunatahiṃ bhayau parbatākārā

verses.sa:
कनक बरन तन तेज बिराजा ।
मानहुँ अपर गिरिन्ह कर राजा ॥
verses.tr:
kanak baran tan tej birājā
mānahum̐ apar girinh kar rājā

verses.sa:
सिंहनाद करि बारहिं बारा ।
लीलहिं नाघउँ जलनिधि खारा ॥
verses.tr:
siṃhanād kari bārahiṃ bārā
līlahiṃ nāghaum̐ jalanidhi khārā

verses.sa:
सहित सहाय रावनहि मारी ।
आनउँ इहाँ त्रिकूट उपारी ॥
verses.tr:
sahit sahāya rāvanahi mārī
ānaum̐ ihām̐ trikūṭ upārī

verses.sa:
जामवंत मैं पूँछउँ तोही ।
उचित सिखावनु दीजहु मोही ॥
verses.tr:
jāmavaṃt maiṃ pūm̐chaum̐ tohī
ucit sikhāvanu dījahu mohī

verses.sa:
एतना करहु तात तुम्ह जाई ।
सीतहि देखि कहहु सुधि आई ॥
verses.tr:
etanā karahu tāt tumh jāī
sītahi dekhi kahahu sudhi āī

verses.sa:
तब निज भुज बल राजिवनैना ।
कौतुक लागि संग कपि सेना ॥
verses.tr:
tab nij bhuj bal rājivanainā
kautuk lāgi saṃg kapi senā

verses.sa:
कपि सेन संग सँघारि निसिचर रामु सीतहि आनिहैं ।
त्रैलोक पावन सुजसु सुर मुनि नारदादि बखानिहैं ॥
verses.tr:
kapi sen saṃg sam̐ghāri nisicar rāmu sītahi ānihaiṃ
trailok pāvan sujasu sur muni nāradādi bakhānihaiṃ
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
जो सुनत गावत कहत समुझत परम पद नर पावई ।
रघुबीर पद पाथोज मधुकर दास तुलसी गावई ॥
verses.tr:
jo sunat gāvat kahat samujhat param pad nar pāvaī
raghubīr pad pāthoj madhukar dās tulasī gāvaī

verses.sa:
भव भेषज रघुनाथ जसु सुनहिं जे नर अरु नारि ।
तिन्ह कर सकल मनोरथ सिद्ध करहिं त्रिसिरारि ॥
verses.tr:
bhav bheṣaj raghunāth jasu sunahiṃ je nar aru nāri
tinh kar sakal manorath siddh karahiṃ trisirāri
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
नीलोत्पल तन स्याम काम कोटि सोभा अधिक ।
सुनिअ तासु गुन ग्राम जासु नाम अघ खग बधिक ॥
verses.tr:
nīlotpal tan syām kām koṭi sobhā adhik
sunia tāsu gun grām jāsu nām agh khag badhik

trans: Angad said: “I will leap across; but I am rather doubtful about getting back again.’ Then said Jambavan: You are quite competent; but why should we send our leader? Hearken, Hanuman,” added the king of the bears, “‘ why is our champion so silent? You are the son of the wind and strong as your sire, a storehouse of good sense, discretion and knowledge; in all the world what undertaking is there so difficult that you, my son, cannot accomplish it? and it is on Rama's account that you have come down upon earth.” On hearing this he swelled to the size of a mountain, with a body of golden hue and of dazzling splendour, as though avery monarch of mountains, and roaring again and again as it were a lion, he cried “1 can easily spring across the salt abyss, and slay Ravan with all his army, and uproot Trikut and bring it here. But I ask you, Jambavan, what I ought to do, give me proper instructions.” ‘All that you have to do, my son, is to go and see Sita and come back with the news. Then the lotus-eyed, by the might of his own arm, taking with him merely for a show his hosts of monkeys.

With his hosts of monkeys Rama will destroy the demons and recover Sita; and gods and saints and Narad and II will declare his glory, that sanctifies the three spheres.” Any man attains the highest beatitude who hears, sings, tells or meditates upon the feet of Raghubir, lotus flowers which, like the bee, Tulsi DAs is ever singing.
